rows.title: 1-NN single query
rows.how_to_grade: Xtr.npy, ytr.npy, q.npy. Return predicted label; exact_match vs reference 1-NN label.

rows.title: Adam with bias correction, step-by-step
rows.how_to_grade: Given grads sequence g.npy, return parameter trajectory; max_abs_err vs reference Adam <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Approximate-NN recall gate (LSH/random hyperplane)
rows.how_to_grade: Given seeded random projections, learner returns candidate top-k; recall@k = |approx∩exact|/k averaged over queries; rel_err(recall, target_recall) within band OR recall>=gate.

rows.title: Brute-force kNN majority vote
rows.how_to_grade: Xtr,ytr,Xte fixtures, k given. argmax_agreement of predicted labels vs sklearn KNeighborsClassifier reference == 1.0 (deterministic tie-break: lowest label).

rows.title: Cosine schedule with linear warmup
rows.how_to_grade: Return lr for each step; max_abs_err vs reference schedule <= 1e-12.

rows.title: Count distance computations: brute vs kd-tree
rows.how_to_grade: Learner instruments a global counter incremented per distance eval; exact_match of (brute_count, kd_count) vs reference, with kd_count below a gate fraction of brute.

rows.title: Covariance-eig vs SVD on ill-conditioned X
rows.how_to_grade: Return components both ways; max_abs_err vs SVD ground truth reveals covariance-route error blowup; SVD route must stay <= 1e-6.

rows.title: Debug AdamW: weight decay folded into gradient
rows.how_to_grade: Fix to decoupled decay; max_abs_err of trajectory vs correct-AdamW reference <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Debug cosine missing normalization / div-by-zero
rows.how_to_grade: Broken fn given; learner fixes. On queries.npy, argmax_agreement of predicted nearest-index vs ref must be 1.0, including a zero-vector row that must not crash.

rows.title: Debug empty-cluster crash / NaN centroid
rows.how_to_grade: Broken update fixed with specified empty-cluster reseed rule; exact_match of final labels on a fixture that empties a cluster.

rows.title: Debug missing centering / wrong normalization
rows.how_to_grade: Fix omitted mean-centering and per-step renorm; max_abs_err of eigenvector vs ref <= 1e-4.

rows.title: Debug off-by-one k / wrong tie-break
rows.how_to_grade: Broken classifier fixed; argmax_agreement==1.0 on adversarial tie fixtures with the specified lowest-label tie rule.

rows.title: Debug softmax wrong axis / no shift
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: Fix axis and add max-shift; mean_kl vs reference <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Debug U/V transpose or component ordering
rows.how_to_grade: Fix swapped factors/descending order; channel_rel_err of projection vs ref <= 1e-6.

rows.title: Decision-boundary labels on a grid
rows.how_to_grade: grid.npy of query points. argmax_agreement of grid labels vs reference kNN >= 0.999.

rows.title: Derive/verify convergence rate (l2/l1)^t
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns predicted per-iter error curve from eigen-gap; rel_err vs empirically measured error decay <= 5e-2.

rows.title: Eckart-Young: error = sum of dropped sigma^2
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns both ||X-Xk||_F^2 and sum_{i>k} sigma_i^2; mse between the two curves over k <= 1e-8.

rows.title: Expansion-trick pairwise, forced vectorized
rows.how_to_grade: Same fixtures. sys.settrace line-event count inside fn must be <= 60 (constant, no n*m Python loop); a double loop emits ~n*m events and fails. Also mse(D,ref)<=1e-8 for correctness.

rows.title: Full AdamW + wd + warmup + clip single step
rows.how_to_grade: One fused step matching reference LLM recipe; max_abs_err of updated params vs reference <= 1e-8.

rows.title: Full Lloyd with fixed init
rows.how_to_grade: X.npy, init.npy, n_iter. Return final labels; exact_match vs reference deterministic Lloyd.

rows.title: Fused cross-entropy from logits
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: logits + integer targets. Return mean CE via log_softmax + gather; max_abs_err vs reference <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Global-norm gradient clipping
rows.how_to_grade: Clip a list of grad tensors by global L2 norm; max_abs_err vs torch-style reference <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Hamming & Jaccard on binary vectors
rows.how_to_grade: B.npy (n×d uint8 0/1). Return integer Hamming matrix and Jaccard matrix; exact_match on integer Hamming counts, rel_err<=1e-12 on Jaccard checked jointly.

rows.title: Iterations to tolerance vs eigen-gap
rows.how_to_grade: Return integer iteration count to reach tol; exact_match vs reference for each of several gap fixtures.

rows.title: k-Means assignment step only
rows.how_to_grade: X.npy, centroids.npy. Return nearest-centroid labels; exact_match vs reference (lowest-index tie-break).

rows.title: k-means++ seeding from given random stream
rows.how_to_grade: Seeded uniform stream u.npy consumed in fixed order for D^2 sampling; exact_match of chosen initial-center indices vs reference.

rows.title: Kahan/Neumaier compensated summation
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: Sum an adversarial float32 array; rel_err vs float64 ground truth <= 1e-6 while naive float32 sum exceeds gate.

rows.title: kd-tree build + exact NN query
rows.how_to_grade: Return nearest-neighbor index per query; exact_match vs brute-force ground truth (ties broken by lowest index).

rows.title: kNN regression averaging
rows.how_to_grade: Regression targets ytr float. Return mean-of-neighbors predictions; rel_err vs reference <= 1e-8.

rows.title: L2 vs cosine neighbor-set divergence
rows.how_to_grade: For each query return sorted top-k index set under each metric and the boolean 'sets differ'. exact_match of the per-query divergence vector vs reference.

rows.title: Leave-one-out kNN accuracy without leakage
rows.how_to_grade: Each point classified excluding itself; argmax_agreement of LOO predictions vs reference ==1.0 (self-distance-zero trap must be excluded).

rows.title: log1p / expm1 for small x
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: For x~1e-8 fixtures, rel_err vs np.log1p/np.expm1 <= 1e-12; naive log(1+x) must lose precision.

rows.title: logsumexp with max-shift
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: Return logsumexp along axis; max_abs_err vs scipy.special.logsumexp <= 1e-10.

rows.title: Low-rank round-trip a weight matrix
rows.how_to_grade: Return rank-k reconstruction; max_abs_err vs reference truncated-SVD reconstruction <= 1e-8.

rows.title: Mahalanobis distance with given covariance
rows.how_to_grade: X.npy, cov_inv.npy. Return pairwise Mahalanobis. rel_err vs cdist(X,X,'mahalanobis',VI=cov_inv) <= 1e-7.

rows.title: Mini-batch k-means deterministic
rows.how_to_grade: Seeded batch index stream; return final centroids; rel_err vs reference mini-batch run <= 1e-6.

rows.title: Naive softmax overflow -> max-subtraction fix
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: logits with |z|~1e3. Return softmax; max_abs_err vs reference stable softmax <= 1e-9 (no nan/inf).

rows.title: Nesterov accelerated gradient
rows.how_to_grade: Return iterate after T steps on quadratic; rel_err vs reference NAG <= 1e-8.

rows.title: Optimal momentum on a quadratic vs kappa
rows.how_to_grade: Return beta*=((sqrt(kappa)-1)/(sqrt(kappa)+1))^2 for each fixture; rel_err vs reference <= 1e-6.

rows.title: Pairwise L1/Manhattan matrix
rows.how_to_grade: X,Y fixtures. mse(D, cdist(X,Y,'cityblock')) <= 1e-12.

rows.title: PCA via SVD: center, decompose, project
rows.how_to_grade: Return k-D projection; channel_rel_err vs reference scores after per-component sign alignment <= 1e-6.

rows.title: Pick rank for 90% energy, report footprint
rows.how_to_grade: Return chosen rank k and size_ratio = (m*k+k+k*n)/(m*n); exact_match on k and rel_err on size_ratio vs reference <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Power iteration vs numpy SVD components
rows.how_to_grade: channel_rel_err between power-iter components and np.linalg.svd components after sign alignment <= 1e-4.

rows.title: Predict converge-vs-diverge from learning rate
rows.how_to_grade: For each lr in list return 0/1 diverge flag; exact_match vs reference stability threshold (lr<2/L).

rows.title: Predict convergence iteration & final labels
rows.how_to_grade: Return integer iters-to-stability and final labels; exact_match on both vs reference.

rows.title: Prove expansion identity is exact
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes both ||a-b||^2 naive and ||a||^2-2a.b+||b||^2 on fixture pairs; grade max_abs_err(expansion, naive) <= 1e-9 elementwise.

rows.title: Prove inertia non-increasing
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns the per-step inertia sequence; grader checks diff(seq)<=1e-9 (monotone) and mse of the sequence vs reference <= 1e-8.

rows.title: Prove logsumexp shift-invariance
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: Return lse(x) and lse(x+c)-c for random c; max_abs_err between them <= 1e-10.

rows.title: Random init vs k-means++ final inertia
rows.how_to_grade: Return final inertia for each seeded init; rel_err vs reference inertias <= 1e-6.

rows.title: Randomized SVD (Halko) from scratch
rows.how_to_grade: Seeded random test matrix; return top-k factors; rel_err of singular values vs exact SVD <= 5e-2 and subspace angle within tol.

rows.title: Rank-k factors without forming full product
rows.how_to_grade: Return U_k,S_k,V_k without materializing m×n reconstruction; settrace/allocation check plus rel_err <= 1e-6 on factors.

rows.title: Rank-k project & reconstruct
rows.how_to_grade: Reconstruct X from top-k power-iter components; mse vs reference rank-k reconstruction <= 1e-4.

rows.title: Read singular values & variance explained
rows.how_to_grade: X.npy. Return cumulative variance-explained ratios; rel_err vs reference <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Recover centroids from assignments + data
rows.how_to_grade: labels.npy, X.npy. Return per-cluster means; max_abs_err vs reference centroids <= 1e-9.

rows.title: Recover embedding from distances (classical MDS)
rows.how_to_grade: D2.npy (squared-dist matrix). Learner double-centers, eigendecomposes, returns k-D coords. rel_err of recovered pairwise distances vs D <= 1e-6 (invariant to rotation).

rows.title: RMSProp / AdaGrad from scratch
rows.how_to_grade: Given grad sequence, return trajectory; max_abs_err vs reference <= 1e-9 (correct eps placement).

rows.title: SGD + momentum on a fixed quadratic
rows.how_to_grade: Quadratic A,b fixtures. Return iterate after T steps; rel_err vs reference <= 1e-8.

rows.title: SGD vs Adam steps-to-tolerance (ill-conditioned)
rows.how_to_grade: Return integer step counts for each; exact_match vs reference.

rows.title: Shifted/inverse iteration for interior eigenvalue
rows.how_to_grade: Given shift sigma, converge to nearest eigenpair via (A-sigma I)^{-1}; rel_err of returned eigenvalue vs reference <= 1e-5.

rows.title: Softmax temperature scaling & range
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: For temperatures in a grid, return softmax; mean_kl vs reference <= 1e-9 including very low T (near-argmax) without overflow.

rows.title: Stable log_softmax
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: max_abs_err vs reference log_softmax <= 1e-10 on large-magnitude logits.

rows.title: Stable sigmoid (branch on sign)
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: max_abs_err vs reference over |z|~1e3; no overflow in exp.

rows.title: Stable softmax on large logits
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: mean_kl(pred, reference) <= 1e-9 over adversarial logit fixtures.

rows.title: Streaming/incremental SVD update
rows.how_to_grade: Given base factors and a new row block, return updated rank-k factors; rel_err of singular values vs full-recompute <= 1e-3.

rows.title: Subspace/block iteration for top-k
rows.how_to_grade: Orthonormalize a block per iter (no per-vector deflation Python loop): settrace count below deflation-loop threshold; components rel_err <= 1e-4.

rows.title: Tiled/blocked pairwise memory-access model
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns modeled cache-line loads for naive vs B-tiled pairwise given (n,d,B,line_size); grade exact_match against closed-form model (deterministic, hardware-independent).

rows.title: Top-1 eigenvector via power iteration
rows.how_to_grade: A.npy, n_iter. Return unit dominant eigenvector; channel_rel_err vs ref eigenvector after sign alignment <= 1e-5.

rows.title: Top-k eigenvectors via deflation
rows.how_to_grade: Return k eigenvectors; rel_err of |V^T V_ref| diagonal to identity and of eigenvalues <= 1e-4 (sign/rotation aligned).

rows.title: Top-k selection via argpartition/heap, no full sort
rows.how_to_grade: settrace count must fall below the n*log n threshold that a full comparison-sort of distances would emit; forbid np.sort/sorted by op-count. Labels still argmax_agreement==1.0.

rows.title: Uniform vs distance-weighted vote divergence
rows.how_to_grade: Return labels under both schemes; argmax_agreement of each vs its reference ==1.0, exercising points where they diverge.

rows.title: Vectorize assignment with expansion trick
rows.how_to_grade: settrace count constant (<=80), no n*k Python loop; labels exact_match vs reference.

rows.title: Vectorized pairwise L2 matrix (no cdist)
rows.how_to_grade: X.npy (n×d), Y.npy (m×d). Return D (n×m). mse(D, scipy.spatial.distance.cdist(X,Y)) <= 1e-12.

rows.title: Welford online variance vs naive
rows.concept: Numerical stability primitives (softmax / logsumexp / stable sums)
rows.how_to_grade: On large-mean small-variance fixture, rel_err of Welford variance vs float64 truth <= 1e-8; naive sum-of-squares must fail.

rows.title: ZCA whitening transform
rows.how_to_grade: Return whitened X; max_abs_err of cov(whitened) vs identity <= 1e-6.

rows.title: 4x4 transpose with vector shuffles
rows.concept: SIMD & explicit vectorization (intrinsics, NEON/AVX, horizontal ops)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner transposes a 4x4 float tile using NEON zip/unzip/transpose intrinsics. Output tile compared byte-exact to reference .npy; gate 1.0. NEON on Mac.

rows.title: ABA problem: identify and fix
rows.how_to_grade: A CAS-based structure is vulnerable to ABA. Learner adds a tagged/versioned pointer; harness runs a forced-ABA scenario and checks the structure's invariant (element conservation) holds; grade invariant bit + contents exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Alias / no-alias classifier (15 pointer pairs)
rows.concept: Aliasing, strict aliasing, restrict & pointer provenance
rows.how_to_grade: For 15 pointer pairs (differing types, char*, same type, derived) learner outputs 0/1 for 'compiler may assume no-alias'. exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: alignas(64) buffer + aligned load path
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: Learner allocates an alignas(64) buffer and fills it; harness asserts (uintptr%64==0) as a bit and compares written bytes to reference .npy. Gate: alignment bit set AND byte_exact_fraction==1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Alive-or-dead lifetime oracle (24 snippets)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner emits a 24-bit vector predicting whether the named object is within its lifetime at the marked line (covers temporaries, const&/&& lifetime extension, static, thread_local, dangling). Bit vector compared to reference; exact_match. Mac.

rows.title: Anonymous namespace vs static internal linkage
rows.concept: Translation model: ODR, linkage, TUs & the one-definition rule
rows.how_to_grade: Learner predicts, for 10 cases, whether anonymous-namespace and file-static give equivalent linkage/behavior. 10-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: AoS→SoA conversion for a single-field sweep
rows.concept: Data layout for cache: AoS vs SoA, false sharing, hot/cold splitting
rows.how_to_grade: Learner converts an AoS token/particle store to SoA. TracedArray counts distinct 64B lines touched by a one-field sweep; grade modeled lines-touched ratio (SoA/AoS) meets target. Mac (model).

rows.title: Arithmetic intensity (FLOPs/byte) of a kernel
rows.concept: Data layout for cache: AoS vs SoA, false sharing, hot/cold splitting
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes FLOPs/byte for a given kernel/config; grade rel_err of the scalar vs reference value (gate rel_err<1e-6). Mac.

rows.title: Array-sum C extension, numeric-exact
rows.concept: CPython C-API extension building: refcounting, GIL & error model
rows.how_to_grade: Learner builds a C-API function summing a float buffer. Result over a fixture .npy compared to numpy reference with rel_err (gate <1e-6); refcounts must also balance. Mac.

rows.title: ASan catches heap overflow → fix
rows.how_to_grade: Kernel writes one past the end of a heap buffer. Learner fixes bounds; harness runs under -fsanitize=address (must be clean = bit) and compares output bytes to reference .npy; gate: ASan-clean AND byte_exact_fraction==1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Atomic counter: correct final value
rows.how_to_grade: Learner uses fetch_add for a shared counter incremented by many threads. The final value is deterministic (== total increments) regardless of interleaving; grade final integer exact_match == reference. Mac.

rows.title: bit_cast float array round-trip through bytes
rows.concept: Advanced lifetime: placement new, storage reuse, std::launder, union active member
rows.how_to_grade: Learner serializes a float32 fixture to a std::byte buffer and recovers it via std::bit_cast (no UB type-pun). Recovered bytes compared to original .npy; gate byte_exact_fraction==1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Bit-field packed int4+int8 quant record
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: Learner packs int4 nibble weights + int8 scale into an exact byte layout matching a spec. Serialized bytes compared to reference .npy byte fixture; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Bit tricks: popcount / clz / round-up-to-pow2
rows.concept: Integer semantics: overflow, promotions, conversions, two's-complement
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements each from scratch (no builtins). Over a fixture of uint fixtures, output integer vectors compared exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Break a shared_ptr cycle with weak_ptr
rows.how_to_grade: A parent/child shared_ptr cycle leaks. Learner converts the back-edge to weak_ptr; Probe dtor_count must equal the object count (no leak). Grade == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Buffer with correct move ctor/assign
rows.concept: Value / copy / move semantics & the special member functions
rows.how_to_grade: A counted allocator tracks allocations/deep-copies. Learner implements a pointer-owning Buffer whose move steals + nulls source. Grade: deep-copy count==0 on moves, alloc==free. Mac.

rows.title: Build a manual vtable dispatcher
rows.concept: Virtual dispatch, vtables & object layout under inheritance
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements dynamic dispatch by hand (struct with a function-pointer table + type tag) reproducing virtual behavior. Over a fixture of calls, output tag/result vector compared exact_match to the real-virtual reference. Mac.

rows.title: By-value factory vs out-parameter copy counts
rows.concept: Copy elision, RVO / NRVO & guaranteed elision
rows.how_to_grade: Learner produces both a by-value (elided) and out-param matrix factory and reports the copy count for each; grade the 2-integer vector == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Cache lines touched: AoS vs padded record
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: A TracedArray records the distinct 64B lines touched during a single-field sweep. Learner reports lines-touched for AoS vs a padded layout; grade both integers == reference. Mac (model).

rows.title: Capsule-owned numpy return without leak
rows.concept: pybind11, the buffer protocol & zero-copy numpy interop
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns a numpy array backed by C++-allocated memory whose lifetime is tied to a capsule/base. Harness checks alloc==free after the array is GC'd (instrumented allocator) and byte-exact contents; grade free_count==alloc_count. Mac.

rows.title: cblas_sgemm C = alpha*A*B + beta*C
rows.concept: Calling BLAS from a C++ extension (GEMM, layout, threading)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner calls cblas_sgemm (Accelerate on Mac). Result C compared to a numpy reference .npy with rel_err (gate <1e-4 for fp32). Mac (Accelerate; CUDA cuBLAS deferred to GPU phase).

rows.title: Classify 12 returns: NRVO / move / copy
rows.concept: Copy elision, RVO / NRVO & guaranteed elision
rows.how_to_grade: For 12 return statements (single/multi path, return param, return prvalue), learner labels NRVO-eligible/move/copy. 12-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Classify strong / basic / nothrow guarantees (12 fns)
rows.concept: Exception safety, stack unwinding & error-handling models
rows.how_to_grade: Learner labels 12 functions with their strongest exception guarantee. 12-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Commit-or-rollback transaction (basic→strong)
rows.concept: Exception safety, stack unwinding & error-handling models
rows.how_to_grade: Learner upgrades a multi-step mutation to all-or-nothing via a staging buffer + single swap-commit. Harness injects a throw at each step; final state bytes must equal the pre-transaction reference at every injection point; gate byte_exact_fraction==1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Compile-time-generated lookup table
rows.concept: Compile-time metaprogramming: constexpr, type traits, TMP
rows.how_to_grade: Learner builds a constexpr std::array LUT (e.g. a fixed-point activation/CRC table) at compile time. The emitted table bytes are compared to a reference .npy; gate byte_exact_fraction==1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Compute lda/ldb/ldc for a submatrix GEMM
rows.concept: Calling BLAS from a C++ extension (GEMM, layout, threading)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner outputs the leading dimensions and pointer offset to multiply a submatrix of a larger buffer. The (lda,ldb,ldc,offset) integer vector compared exact_match to reference; the resulting GEMM must also match within rel_err. Mac.

rows.title: concept-constrained function accept/reject
rows.concept: Templates: instantiation, overload resolution, SFINAE & concepts
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a concept constraint; a harness probes 12 types for whether the constrained call is viable (via requires-expression at runtime-reflected bool). 12-bit accept/reject vector exact_match vs reference. Mac (C++20).

rows.title: const_cast-then-write UB — fix
rows.how_to_grade: Kernel const_casts away const on a genuinely-const object and writes, miscompiling at -O2. Learner restructures to a legitimately mutable buffer. Output bytes vs reference .npy under -O2; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Const-correct MatrixView type
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a view whose const overload returns read-only access and non-const overload permits writes. Harness writes through the mutable view then reads via const view; result bytes vs reference .npy, gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: const-overload ABI distinctness via mangling
rows.how_to_grade: Learner reports the mangled symbol names of const vs non-const member overloads; harness extracts actual symbols via nm and compares learner's predicted strings exact. Mac (Itanium ABI).

rows.title: Constant-folding classifier
rows.concept: The optimizer: inlining, constant folding, LICM, autovectorization
rows.how_to_grade: Learner marks which of 12 expressions fold to a compile-time constant. 12-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: constexpr integer sqrt / is_prime
rows.concept: Compile-time metaprogramming: constexpr, type traits, TMP
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes constexpr functions evaluated at compile time; harness emits the results over a fixture of inputs and compares the integer vector exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: constexpr matrix multiply of fixed matrices
rows.concept: Compile-time metaprogramming: constexpr, type traits, TMP
rows.how_to_grade: Learner multiplies two compile-time-known small matrices in a constexpr function; emitted result compared to a reference .npy with rel_err (gate <1e-6). Mac.

rows.title: Copy-and-swap for the strong exception guarantee
rows.concept: Exception safety, stack unwinding & error-handling models
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements assignment via copy-and-swap so a throw mid-assign leaves the target unchanged. Harness forces a throw, then reads target bytes; compare to the pre-assign reference .npy; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Copy count across value / const-ref / ref params
rows.how_to_grade: Three variants of a hot function take Probe by value, const&, and &. Learner predicts/produces the copy-ctor count for each; grade the 3-integer vector == reference copy-ctor counters. Mac.

rows.title: Correct error propagation (set exc, return NULL)
rows.concept: CPython C-API extension building: refcounting, GIL & error model
rows.how_to_grade: For invalid inputs, learner's extension must set the correct exception and return NULL. Harness asserts the raised exception type name over a fixture of bad inputs; type-name vector exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Count deep copies vs moves in a batch pipeline
rows.concept: Value / copy / move semantics & the special member functions
rows.how_to_grade: A container-of-Buffer workload runs; Probe increments per-operation counters. Learner reports (copy_count, move_count); grade both integers == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Count reallocations & element moves on push_back
rows.concept: STL container internals: vector, deque, node containers, hash maps
rows.how_to_grade: Probe elements count moves; a counting allocator counts reallocations during an N-push sequence. Learner reports (realloc_count, move_count); grade both == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Dangling reference to lifetime-extended temporary — fix
rows.how_to_grade: Broken function returns const& to a temporary. Learner fixes ownership; harness reads the returned value's raw bytes and compares to a reference float32 .npy; score = fraction of matching bytes (gate 1.0). Mac.

rows.title: Define AoS vs SoA (label 10 layouts)
rows.concept: Data layout for cache: AoS vs SoA, false sharing, hot/cold splitting
rows.how_to_grade: Learner labels 10 given data layouts as AoS or SoA. 10-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Demangle 12 mangled names
rows.concept: Linking, name mangling, ABI & symbol visibility
rows.how_to_grade: Learner recovers the human signature for 12 mangled names; compared exact_match to c++filt reference output. Mac.

rows.title: Deque index → (block, offset) mapping
rows.concept: STL container internals: vector, deque, node containers, hash maps
rows.how_to_grade: Given a block size, learner outputs the (block, offset) pair for 20 linear indices under a std::deque-style map. 20-pair vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Destructor order under exception unwinding
rows.how_to_grade: Nested scopes hold several Probe locals; a throw unwinds mid-way. Learner emits the ordered list of dtor ids that actually fire during unwinding; compared exact to reference order. Mac.

rows.title: Detection-idiom has_member type trait
rows.concept: Templates: instantiation, overload resolution, SFINAE & concepts
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements a has_serialize<T> trait via the detection idiom; harness instantiates it over 12 types and compares the resulting bool table to reference exact_match. Mac.

rows.title: Double-checked locking init exactly once
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements correct lazy init (atomic flag + mutex, or call_once). An init counter must read exactly 1 after many threads race; grade init_count exact_match == 1. Mac.

rows.title: dtype/shape mismatch error handling
rows.concept: pybind11, the buffer protocol & zero-copy numpy interop
rows.how_to_grade: Learner's binding must raise the correct exception for wrong dtype/ndim/shape inputs. Over a fixture of bad arrays, the raised exception-type-name vector compared exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Erase-remove idiom correct result
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements the erase-remove idiom to delete matching elements; resulting container contents compared exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Error-code vs exception result equivalence
rows.concept: Exception safety, stack unwinding & error-handling models
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements the same operation with std::expected/error-codes and with exceptions; harness feeds fixture inputs and compares the returned status/value vectors of both paths to the reference; exact_match. Mac.

rows.title: extern "C" to fix a mangling link error
rows.concept: Linking, name mangling, ABI & symbol visibility
rows.how_to_grade: A C++ symbol fails to resolve from a C-style consumer due to mangling. Learner adds extern "C"; harness links and runs, comparing output exact_match to reference (link must succeed). Mac.

rows.title: Factory returns with exactly one construction
rows.concept: Copy elision, RVO / NRVO & guaranteed elision
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a prvalue-returning factory for a Probe Buffer; guaranteed elision must yield total ctor_count==1 (no copies/moves). Grade the counter == 1. Mac.

rows.title: False-sharing classifier (10 access patterns)
rows.concept: Data layout for cache: AoS vs SoA, false sharing, hot/cold splitting
rows.how_to_grade: Learner marks which of 10 per-thread access patterns suffer false sharing. 10-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Fix a binding that copies instead of viewing
rows.concept: pybind11, the buffer protocol & zero-copy numpy interop
rows.how_to_grade: A binding returns a copy (owns its data). Learner switches to a capsule-owned zero-copy view; harness asserts np.shares_memory==True; boolean compared exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Fix a data race with correct atomics (TSan)
rows.how_to_grade: A shared flag is accessed non-atomically. Learner converts to std::atomic with proper ordering; harness runs under -fsanitize=thread across repeated trials and reports a race-free bit + correct result; both compared exact_match to reference. Mac (TSan).

rows.title: Fix a Py_DECREF leak
rows.concept: CPython C-API extension building: refcounting, GIL & error model
rows.how_to_grade: An extension forgets to DECREF an owned temporary. Learner fixes it; harness measures the refcount of a probe object across many calls and requires net delta == 0. Grade == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Fix an ambiguous overload / broken SFINAE
rows.concept: Templates: instantiation, overload resolution, SFINAE & concepts
rows.how_to_grade: Code fails to compile due to ambiguity/hard SFINAE error. Learner fixes constraints so it compiles and each call routes to the intended overload; observed tag vector == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Fix an ODR violation across TUs
rows.concept: Translation model: ODR, linkage, TUs & the one-definition rule
rows.how_to_grade: Two TUs define the same inline function/type differently (ODR violation, one-definition-rule). Learner reconciles them; harness links and runs, comparing program output exact_match to reference (and link must succeed). Mac.

rows.title: Fix borrowed/stolen-reference misuse
rows.concept: CPython C-API extension building: refcounting, GIL & error model
rows.how_to_grade: Code over-decrefs a borrowed reference (from PyList_GetItem) / mishandles a stolen reference (PyTuple_SET_ITEM). Learner corrects ownership; harness verifies refcount deltas of inputs == 0 across calls and no crash. Grade == reference deltas. Mac.

rows.title: Fix erase-while-iterating loop
rows.how_to_grade: A loop erases elements without using erase()'s return, invalidating the iterator. Learner fixes it; harness compares the resulting container contents vector exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Fix false sharing by 64B padding
rows.concept: Data layout for cache: AoS vs SoA, false sharing, hot/cold splitting
rows.how_to_grade: Per-thread counters share a cache line. A modeled coherence tracker counts cross-thread writes to the same 64B line. Learner pads counters to 64B; grade modeled shared-line write count == 0. Mac (model).

rows.title: Fix row-major vs col-major GEMM call
rows.concept: Calling BLAS from a C++ extension (GEMM, layout, threading)
rows.how_to_grade: A GEMM call uses the wrong CBLAS_ORDER/transpose flags, producing a transposed/garbled result. Learner fixes the order/trans args; output compared to reference with rel_err (gate <1e-4). Mac (Accelerate).

rows.title: Fix SIMD tail/remainder handling
rows.concept: SIMD & explicit vectorization (intrinsics, NEON/AVX, horizontal ops)
rows.how_to_grade: A SIMD loop drops the last N%4 elements. Learner adds a scalar remainder loop; output over a non-multiple-of-4 fixture compared byte-exact to reference; gate 1.0. NEON on Mac.

rows.title: Fix UB left-shift of negative / oversized shift
rows.concept: Integer semantics: overflow, promotions, conversions, two's-complement
rows.how_to_grade: Code shifts a negative signed value / shifts by >= width. Learner switches to unsigned and clamps shift; output over a fixture compared byte-exact to reference; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: FLOP count of a GEMM configuration
rows.concept: Calling BLAS from a C++ extension (GEMM, layout, threading)
rows.how_to_grade: Given (M,N,K,alpha,beta), learner outputs the exact FLOP count (2*M*N*K plus beta/alpha terms). Integer compared exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: From-scratch blocked GEMM microkernel
rows.concept: Calling BLAS from a C++ extension (GEMM, layout, threading)
rows.how_to_grade: settrace/line-count harness FORBIDS a numpy/BLAS shortcut in the hot path (a numpy call emits ~0 line events; a real triple loop over N emits ~N). Learner writes a cache-blocked fp32 GEMM; output compared to BLAS reference with max_abs_err (gate <1e-3). Mac.

rows.title: Full offset/size table for a struct
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: Learner outputs (offsetof,sizeof) for every member plus total sizeof as a tuple vector; harness compares to the compiler's actual offsetof/sizeof values exact. Mac.

rows.title: GGUF-style Q4_0 block pack/unpack round-trip
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: Learner packs 32 int4 weights + one fp16 scale into a ggml Q4_0 block and unpacks it. Packed bytes compared to reference block fixture; gate byte_exact_fraction==1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Growth policy: reproduce the capacity sequence
rows.concept: STL container internals: vector, deque, node containers, hash maps
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements a vector with a specified growth factor; harness records capacity() after each of N push_backs and compares the capacity trace vector exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Handle strided / non-contiguous input
rows.concept: pybind11, the buffer protocol & zero-copy numpy interop
rows.how_to_grade: Learner's kernel respects buffer_info strides on a non-contiguous slice. Output compared to numpy reference with rel_err (gate <1e-6). Mac.

rows.title: Hidden visibility reduces exported symbols
rows.concept: Linking, name mangling, ABI & symbol visibility
rows.how_to_grade: Learner applies -fvisibility=hidden + explicit exports so only the public API is dynamic. Harness counts exported symbols via nm -gU; grade exported-symbol count == target. Mac.

rows.title: Hoist loop-invariant load by hand (LICM)
rows.concept: The optimizer: inlining, constant folding, LICM, autovectorization
rows.how_to_grade: AccessCountedPtr logs loads. Learner hoists a loop-invariant load/computation out of the loop; grade modeled load count drops to the reference hoisted count. Mac (model).

rows.title: Hot/cold field split to hit a footprint ratio
rows.concept: Data layout for cache: AoS vs SoA, false sharing, hot/cold splitting
rows.how_to_grade: Learner splits a struct into hot/cold arrays; grade size_ratio = hot-sweep footprint / original footprint meets the target. Footprint from summed sizeof of touched hot arrays. Mac.

rows.title: In-place C++ modify reflects in numpy
rows.concept: pybind11, the buffer protocol & zero-copy numpy interop
rows.how_to_grade: Learner's binding mutates the numpy buffer in place. After the call, the numpy array bytes are compared to the reference modified .npy; gate byte_exact_fraction==1.0 (confirms true zero-copy write). Mac.

rows.title: In-place vs out-of-place vectorization legality
rows.concept: Aliasing, strict aliasing, restrict & pointer provenance
rows.how_to_grade: For 10 elementwise kernels with various input/output overlap, learner marks which are safe to vectorize without a runtime overlap check. 10-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: int8 quantize / dequantize round-trip
rows.concept: Integer semantics: overflow, promotions, conversions, two's-complement
rows.how_to_grade: Learner quantizes a float32 fixture to int8 (two's complement, correct rounding) and dequantizes. Reconstruction compared to reference with max_abs_err (gate <= scale/2 + eps). Mac.

rows.title: int8 widening dot product (NEON)
rows.concept: SIMD & explicit vectorization (intrinsics, NEON/AVX, horizontal ops)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes an int8·int8→int32 dot product with widening NEON intrinsics. Integer result vector compared exact_match to reference (integer math is bit-exact). NEON on Mac.

rows.title: Integer promotion/conversion result prediction
rows.concept: Integer semantics: overflow, promotions, conversions, two's-complement
rows.how_to_grade: For 20 mixed-type arithmetic expressions, learner outputs the resulting value AND result type id. Harness executes them; learner's (value,type) vector compared exact_match to observed. Mac.

rows.title: Iterator-invalidation oracle (20 ops)
rows.how_to_grade: 20 container-op scenarios across vector/deque/list/map insert/erase; learner emits 0/1 for whether a held iterator remains valid. 20-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Leak-free half-built object on throw
rows.concept: Exception safety, stack unwinding & error-handling models
rows.how_to_grade: A ctor allocates two buffers; the second allocation throws, leaking the first. Learner adds RAII members; instrumented allocator verifies free_count==alloc_count on the exception path. Mac.

rows.title: Level-1/2 BLAS: axpy + gemv correctness
rows.concept: Calling BLAS from a C++ extension (GEMM, layout, threading)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner calls cblas_saxpy and cblas_sgemv with correct increments/transpose. Outputs compared to numpy references with rel_err (gate <1e-5). Mac (Accelerate).

rows.title: Linkage classifier (15 declarations)
rows.concept: Translation model: ODR, linkage, TUs & the one-definition rule
rows.how_to_grade: Learner labels each of 15 declarations internal/external/no-linkage. 15-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Load-factor rehash trigger count
rows.concept: STL container internals: vector, deque, node containers, hash maps
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements rehash at a specified max load factor; a counter increments on each rehash during an insert sequence. Grade rehash_count == reference. Mac.

rows.title: make_shared vs shared_ptr(new) allocation count
rows.how_to_grade: Overridden operator new counts allocations. Learner builds both forms; grade alloc_count(make_shared)==1 and alloc_count(shared_ptr(new))==2 == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Map UB category label to 15 snippets
rows.how_to_grade: Learner assigns each of 15 snippets a category from a fixed taxonomy (e.g. lifetime, aliasing, integer, bounds, data-race, sequencing). 15-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Memory-order reordering legality (12 cases)
rows.how_to_grade: For 12 pairs of ops under a stated memory_order, learner marks whether reordering is permitted. 12-bit vector exact_match vs reference (from the C++ memory model). Mac.

rows.title: Message-passing litmus: allowed outcomes
rows.how_to_grade: Learner enumerates the set of allowed final register states for a release/acquire message-passing litmus test. Set compared exact_match to the model reference. Mac (no thread execution needed).

rows.title: Mini-variant active-member switch
rows.concept: Advanced lifetime: placement new, storage reuse, std::launder, union active member
rows.how_to_grade: Tagged union stores one of two Probe-instrumented types. On type switch the old active member must be destroyed before the new is constructed. Grade the exact ctor/dtor event sequence string == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Minimize distinct template instantiations
rows.concept: Templates: instantiation, overload resolution, SFINAE & concepts
rows.how_to_grade: Each unique instantiation increments a per-type static registered in a global set at first use. Learner refactors (type erasure / common base) to reduce distinct instantiations; grade the distinct-instantiation count == target. Mac.

rows.title: Move ctor forgets to null → double-free fix
rows.concept: Value / copy / move semantics & the special member functions
rows.how_to_grade: Broken move ctor leaves source pointing at stolen memory, causing double-free. Learner fixes; instrumented allocator verifies free_count == alloc_count exactly. Mac.

rows.title: Multiple accumulators to break FP dep chain
rows.concept: The optimizer: inlining, constant folding, LICM, autovectorization
rows.how_to_grade: Learner rewrites a reduction with K independent accumulators. Harness verifies the accumulator count == K (structural, via a required output) and the result matches the reference sum within rel_err (gate <1e-5). Mac.

rows.title: Multiple-inheritance this-pointer adjustment
rows.concept: Virtual dispatch, vtables & object layout under inheritance
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes the this-pointer offset (thunk adjustment) when casting a most-derived object to each base under multiple inheritance. Offset vector compared exact_match to actual pointer-diff reference. Mac (Itanium ABI).

rows.title: Name the storage duration
rows.how_to_grade: 20 variable declarations; learner outputs one label per variable from {automatic,static,thread,dynamic}. Compare the 20-label vector against the fixed reference vector; exact_match requires all 20 correct.

rows.title: NEON f32x4 saxpy from intrinsics
rows.concept: SIMD & explicit vectorization (intrinsics, NEON/AVX, horizontal ops)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes y = a*x+y with NEON intrinsics (elementwise, same op order as scalar → bit-exact). Output compared byte-exact to scalar reference .npy; gate 1.0. NEON on Mac (AVX variant deferred to x86 phase).

rows.title: NEON horizontal-sum dot product
rows.concept: SIMD & explicit vectorization (intrinsics, NEON/AVX, horizontal ops)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes a dot product with NEON multiply-accumulate + horizontal reduction. Result compared to reference with rel_err (gate <1e-5; FP reassociation tolerated). NEON on Mac.

rows.title: noexcept move unlocks vector-growth moves
rows.concept: Value / copy / move semantics & the special member functions
rows.how_to_grade: Learner marks the move ctor noexcept so std::vector reallocation moves rather than copies. Probe copy-ctor count during reserve/growth must drop to 0; grade == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Open-addressing hash map probe sequence
rows.concept: STL container internals: vector, deque, node containers, hash maps
rows.how_to_grade: With a fixed hash + linear probing, learner implements insert; harness records the slot index used for each of N inserts and compares the probe-position vector exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Overload resolution winner (15 calls)
rows.concept: Templates: instantiation, overload resolution, SFINAE & concepts
rows.how_to_grade: Each candidate overload returns a distinct tag id. Learner predicts the winning tag for 15 calls; harness runs them, compares learner's predicted 15-id vector to the observed tags exact_match. Mac.

rows.title: Peak live-object count under a workload
rows.how_to_grade: Probe ctor increments / dtor decrements a global live-count, tracking its max. Learner completes a workload; grade the recorded peak integer == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Pick the right smart pointer (12 scenarios)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner chooses unique/shared/weak/raw for 12 ownership scenarios. 12-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Pick the weakest correct memory_order (8 patterns)
rows.how_to_grade: For 8 synchronization patterns, learner selects the weakest memory_order that keeps it correct. 8-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Placement-new one object then explicit destroy
rows.concept: Advanced lifetime: placement new, storage reuse, std::launder, union active member
rows.how_to_grade: Learner constructs one Probe into a raw aligned buffer with placement new and destroys it via explicit dtor call. Grade: ctor_count==1 and dtor_count==1 (no double-construct, no leak). Mac.

rows.title: Portable checked-overflow detection
rows.concept: Integer semantics: overflow, promotions, conversions, two's-complement
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a would-overflow predicate for signed add/mul without triggering UB. Over a fixture of int pairs, the overflow-flag vector is compared exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Predict mangled names for 12 signatures
rows.concept: Linking, name mangling, ABI & symbol visibility
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes the Itanium-ABI mangled name for 12 function/overload signatures; harness compiles and extracts actual symbols via nm; predicted string vector compared exact_match. Mac.

rows.title: Predict refcount after 12 C-API operations
rows.concept: CPython C-API extension building: refcounting, GIL & error model
rows.how_to_grade: Given 12 sequences of New/Incref/Decref/borrowed-get, learner predicts the final refcount of a tracked object. 12-integer vector exact_match vs sys.getrefcount reference. Mac.

rows.title: Predict sizeof of a small struct
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: Given a 2-3 field struct, learner outputs its sizeof integer. Compared exact to reference sizeof (LP64). Mac.

rows.title: Predict symbol-definition count for a header
rows.concept: Translation model: ODR, linkage, TUs & the one-definition rule
rows.how_to_grade: A header used in 3 TUs mixes inline/static/extern definitions. Learner predicts how many symbol definitions appear across object files; harness counts via nm and compares learner's integer(s) == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Predict which loops autovectorize
rows.concept: The optimizer: inlining, constant folding, LICM, autovectorization
rows.how_to_grade: Learner emits a 12-bit vector predicting which loops the compiler can autovectorize (blocked by reduction dep, aliasing, early exit, function call, etc.). Compared exact_match to the fixed reference (rule-based). Mac.

rows.title: Predict which snippets UBSan flags
rows.how_to_grade: Learner predicts a 15-bit vector of which snippets -fsanitize=undefined reports. Harness runs each under UBSan and parses reports; learner's prediction vector compared exact_match to the parsed reference. Mac (clang UBSan).

rows.title: Producer/consumer conservation (condvar)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner builds a mutex+condition_variable bounded queue. Sum of items produced must equal sum consumed (deterministic invariant); grade (sum_in==sum_out) bit + item multiset exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Read a nested pointer/reference/const declaration
rows.how_to_grade: 12 declarations; learner labels each as e.g. 'pointer-to-const-int','const-pointer-to-int','ref-to-const'. Label vector compared exact to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Read/write/rebind legality (3 bits × 20)
rows.how_to_grade: For 20 declarations, learner emits 3 legality bits (may-read, may-write-through, may-rebind). 60-bit vector compared exact to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Redundant-load delta: aliased vs restrict accumulation
rows.concept: Aliasing, strict aliasing, restrict & pointer provenance
rows.how_to_grade: Using AccessCountedPtr, learner produces both the pessimistic (reload-per-iter) and hoisted accumulation loops and reports the load-count delta; grade delta == reference. Mac (model).

rows.title: Refactor two return paths to preserve NRVO
rows.concept: Copy elision, RVO / NRVO & guaranteed elision
rows.how_to_grade: Function has two returns of different named locals (NRVO inhibited). Learner restructures to a single named return object; Probe move/copy count must hit the NRVO reference (0). Mac.

rows.title: Refcount balance for a new-tuple returner
rows.concept: CPython C-API extension building: refcounting, GIL & error model
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a C-API function returning a new tuple. Harness records sys.getrefcount of the inputs before/after and of the result; the refcount deltas must equal the reference integers exactly. Mac (CPython).

rows.title: Remove an autovectorization blocker
rows.concept: The optimizer: inlining, constant folding, LICM, autovectorization
rows.how_to_grade: A loop is un-vectorizable due to a false dependency/aliasing. Learner restructures it (restrict / accumulator split) while preserving semantics; output over fixture compared byte-exact to reference; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: remove_cv / decay trait from scratch
rows.concept: Compile-time metaprogramming: constexpr, type traits, TMP
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements a decay-like trait; harness compares std::is_same<learner_result, std_result> over 15 input types as a bool table exact_match vs reference (must equal std::decay). Mac.

rows.title: Remove return std::move pessimization
rows.concept: Copy elision, RVO / NRVO & guaranteed elision
rows.how_to_grade: A 'return std::move(local)' blocks NRVO forcing a move. Learner removes it; Probe move_count must drop to reference (0 for NRVO). Grade == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Reorder struct members to minimize sizeof
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: Learner reorders fields; grade size_ratio = sizeof(optimized)/sizeof(naive) meets the target ratio (e.g. <=0.67). Layout measured with sizeof at runtime. Mac.

rows.title: Replace shared_ptr with unique_ptr where sole-owned
rows.how_to_grade: A wrapper counts atomic refcount incr/decr on shared_ptr copies. Learner swaps to unique_ptr for sole-ownership paths; grade modeled atomic-op count drops to 0 == reference. Mac (model).

rows.title: Reproduce a target ctor/copy/move/dtor event sequence
rows.concept: Value / copy / move semantics & the special member functions
rows.how_to_grade: Given a target event string (e.g. 'C M C D D'), learner writes code that makes the Probe emit exactly that sequence. Emitted log compared exact to target (op-counts exact sequence). Mac.

rows.title: reserve() to prevent pointer invalidation
rows.how_to_grade: A loop caches pointers into a growing vector; learner adds reserve() so no reallocation occurs. Counting allocator verifies realloc_count==0; grade == reference. Mac.

rows.title: restrict-enabled load hoist on saxpy/gemv
rows.concept: Aliasing, strict aliasing, restrict & pointer provenance
rows.how_to_grade: Inputs are wrapped in an AccessCountedPtr that logs every load. Learner rewrites the loop to hoist the provably-non-aliasing scalar/base loads out (what __restrict__ authorizes). Grade modeled load count == reference reduced count. Mac (model, hardware-independent).

rows.title: Saturating add/sub/mul without UB
rows.concept: Integer semantics: overflow, promotions, conversions, two's-complement
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements saturating int ops with no signed-overflow UB. Applied to a fixture of int32 pairs .npy; output compared byte-exact to reference saturated results; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Scalar vs SIMD equivalence classifier
rows.concept: SIMD & explicit vectorization (intrinsics, NEON/AVX, horizontal ops)
rows.how_to_grade: For 10 kernels, learner predicts whether the SIMD version is bit-identical to scalar or only close (FP reassociation in reductions). 10-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Scoped arena: LIFO ctor/dtor order
rows.how_to_grade: A provided Probe type appends 'C<id>'/'D<id>' to a global event log in its ctor/dtor. Learner's arena must destroy in reverse construction order. Grade the emitted event-sequence string against reference (exact ctor/dtor sequence). Mac.

rows.title: SFINAE-select int vs float code path
rows.concept: Templates: instantiation, overload resolution, SFINAE & concepts
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes an enable_if-dispatched function; the executed specialization records a tag. Over a fixture of typed calls, grade the tag vector == reference (right path chosen each time). Mac.

rows.title: shared_ptr aliasing constructor: subobject ownership
rows.how_to_grade: Learner uses the aliasing constructor to hand out a pointer to a subobject while keeping the parent alive. Probe verifies the parent dtor fires only after the last alias dies; grade dtor-order log == reference. Mac.

rows.title: Single-inheritance object layout offsets
rows.concept: Virtual dispatch, vtables & object layout under inheritance
rows.how_to_grade: Learner outputs the offset of the vptr and each member for a derived class. Offset vector compared exact_match to compiler offsetof/pointer-diff reference. Mac (Itanium ABI).

rows.title: sizeof with vs without a virtual (vptr)
rows.concept: Virtual dispatch, vtables & object layout under inheritance
rows.how_to_grade: Learner outputs sizeof for a class before/after adding a virtual function. Two-integer vector compared exact_match to the compiler's actual sizeof (accounts for vptr). Mac.

rows.title: Slab storage reuse: stale pointer + launder fix
rows.concept: Advanced lifetime: placement new, storage reuse, std::launder, union active member
rows.how_to_grade: A slab reuses one storage slot for a new object; a stale pointer reads it. Learner inserts std::launder / re-derives the pointer so the read is correct under -O2. Output bytes vs reference .npy; gate 1.0. Mac (compile -O2).

rows.title: small_vector<T,N> with inline storage
rows.concept: Advanced lifetime: placement new, storage reuse, std::launder, union active member
rows.how_to_grade: Learner builds inline-buffer vector using placement new + manual dtor calls and heap spill past N. Counted Probe verifies ctor_count==dtor_count, zero double-construct, and correct element values via a checksum. Mac.

rows.title: SPSC ring buffer: no loss / no duplication
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a bounded single-producer/single-consumer queue with acquire/release indices. Consumer's received sequence must equal the produced sequence exactly; grade received vector exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Standard-layout / trivially-copyable flags (12 structs)
rows.concept: Memory layout: alignment, padding, offsetof, struct packing
rows.how_to_grade: Learner emits 2 bits per struct (is_standard_layout, is_trivially_copyable). 24-bit vector compared exact to std::type_traits reference. Mac.

rows.title: Static-init-order fiasco → Meyers singleton
rows.how_to_grade: Two TUs with cross-dependent namespace-scope globals log their init order. Learner converts to function-local statics; harness prints the init-order log string and compares exact to reference (fiasco removed). Mac.

rows.title: Store-buffering (Dekker) outcome enumeration
rows.how_to_grade: Learner lists the allowed outcomes of store-buffering under relaxed vs seq_cst. Outcome set compared exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Strength reduction (mul→add) preserving result
rows.concept: The optimizer: inlining, constant folding, LICM, autovectorization
rows.how_to_grade: Learner replaces an index*stride multiply in a loop with an additive induction variable. Output over an integer fixture compared byte-exact to reference; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: Strict-aliasing divergence O0 vs O2
rows.concept: Aliasing, strict aliasing, restrict & pointer provenance
rows.how_to_grade: Learner constructs a program whose UB type-pun yields identical output at -O0 but different at -O2, and repairs it. Harness compares repaired output bytes at both opt levels to a single reference .npy; gate byte_exact_fraction==1.0 at both. Mac.

rows.title: Sync-pattern correctness classifier
rows.how_to_grade: Learner labels 10 synchronization snippets as ok / data-race / deadlock. 10-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Threaded GEMM matches single-thread within tol
rows.concept: Calling BLAS from a C++ extension (GEMM, layout, threading)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner parallelizes GEMM over row blocks with std::thread. Output compared to the single-thread reference with max_abs_err (gate <1e-3); result must be independent of thread count. Mac.

rows.title: Treiber lock-free stack: multiset conservation
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements a lock-free stack (CAS). N producers push known values, M consumers pop; the multiset of popped values must equal the pushed multiset regardless of interleaving. Grade the sorted popped multiset exact_match to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Two's-complement bit patterns → values
rows.concept: Integer semantics: overflow, promotions, conversions, two's-complement
rows.how_to_grade: Given 20 hex/bit patterns and a signed/unsigned width, learner outputs the decimal value each represents. 20-integer vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Type-pun float via int* miscompile — memcpy fix
rows.concept: Aliasing, strict aliasing, restrict & pointer provenance
rows.how_to_grade: Kernel reads a float buffer through int* (strict-aliasing violation) and breaks at -O2. Learner replaces with memcpy/bit_cast. Output bytes vs reference .npy compiled -O2; gate 1.0. Mac.

rows.title: UB-driven check elimination O0 vs O2
rows.how_to_grade: Learner constructs a case where a null/overflow check is elided at -O2 due to UB, then fixes it. Harness records whether the guarded branch executes at -O0 vs -O2 as a 2-bit outcome; after the fix both bits must match the reference (branch preserved). Mac.

rows.title: UB oracle: 15 placement-new/union/launder snippets
rows.concept: Advanced lifetime: placement new, storage reuse, std::launder, union active member
rows.how_to_grade: Learner outputs a 15-bit vector marking which snippets are UB (wrong active member, missing dtor before reuse, missing launder after storage reuse). exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: UB taxonomy classifier (20 snippets)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner emits a 20-bit vector marking which snippets are UB (signed overflow, OOB read, uninit use, null deref, oversized shift, strict-aliasing). exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: unique_ptr-like handle with custom deleter
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a move-only handle wrapping a fake GPU handle; the custom deleter increments a release counter. Across normal and exception exit paths, grade release_count==1 exactly. Mac.

rows.title: Value category of 15 expressions
rows.concept: Value / copy / move semantics & the special member functions
rows.how_to_grade: Learner labels each of 15 expressions lvalue/xvalue/prvalue. 15-label vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Virtual-call indirection cost (modeled)
rows.concept: Virtual dispatch, vtables & object layout under inheritance
rows.how_to_grade: A model charges one indirect load (vptr) + one (vtable slot) per virtual call. Learner reports total modeled indirect loads for a virtual loop vs a devirtualized version; grade both integers == reference. Mac (model).

rows.title: What may appear in multiple TUs (classify)
rows.concept: Translation model: ODR, linkage, TUs & the one-definition rule
rows.how_to_grade: Learner marks which of 12 constructs may be defined in multiple TUs without ODR violation (class, inline fn, template, non-inline fn, non-const global, etc.). 12-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Which expressions are constant expressions (classify)
rows.concept: Compile-time metaprogramming: constexpr, type traits, TMP
rows.how_to_grade: Learner marks which of 12 expressions are usable in a constant-expression context. Harness confirms each with a static_assert/constexpr probe; 12-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Which override is called (12 calls)
rows.concept: Virtual dispatch, vtables & object layout under inheritance
rows.how_to_grade: Each override returns a distinct tag. Learner predicts the tag for 12 calls through base pointers/references/objects (static vs dynamic type). Predicted 12-tag vector compared exact_match to observed. Mac.

rows.title: Which refs survive vector growth (classify)
rows.how_to_grade: For 12 mixed insert/reserve sequences, learner predicts whether a previously-taken reference is still valid afterward. 12-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Which special members are implicitly generated
rows.concept: Value / copy / move semantics & the special member functions
rows.how_to_grade: For 10 class definitions, learner outputs which of the 6 special members are declared/defaulted/deleted (6 bits each). Vector compared exact to reference. Mac.

rows.title: Which struct change breaks ABI (classify)
rows.concept: Linking, name mangling, ABI & symbol visibility
rows.how_to_grade: For 12 struct/interface edits (reorder, add field, change type, add virtual), learner marks ABI-breaking vs compatible. 12-bit vector exact_match vs reference. Mac.

rows.title: Zero-copy numpy view via buffer protocol
rows.concept: pybind11, the buffer protocol & zero-copy numpy interop
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns a numpy array that aliases the input's memory. Harness checks np.shares_memory(in,out)==True and equal .ctypes.data pointers; both booleans compared exact_match to reference (True,True). Mac.

rows.title: 2-bit saturating-counter mispredict count
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture: .npy branch-outcome bit trace. Learner simulates a per-branch 2-bit predictor; exact_match on mispredict count. Mac today.

rows.title: 3-level inclusive hierarchy miss vector
rows.how_to_grade: Same trace fed through L1->L2->L3->DRAM with inclusion enforced. Learner emits per-level miss count vector; exact_match vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: 4KB vs 2MB huge-page TLB miss comparison
rows.how_to_grade: Same trace, two page sizes; learner returns (miss_4k, miss_huge) pair; exact_match. Mac variant uses 16KB base + huge page. Mac today.

rows.title: Address to (tag, set, offset)
rows.how_to_grade: For configurable (size,ways,line) learner decomposes each address; exact_match on (tag,set,offset) triples over a .npy address array. Mac today.

rows.title: Address to (VPN, page offset)
rows.how_to_grade: For configurable page size (4KB / 16KB Apple), learner splits addresses into (VPN,offset); exact_match over a .npy address array. Mac today.

rows.title: Aligned allocator verified over 1000 allocs
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes an align-to-A allocator (over a byte arena); exact_match on count of correctly aligned pointers = 1000. Mac today.

rows.title: Alignment-aware allocation wasted bytes
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes bytes wasted to alignment across a request sequence; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: AMAT from a fixed latency ladder
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture .npy of per-level hit rates + published latency constants (L1/L2/L3/DRAM cycles). Learner computes AMAT = L1_lat + miss1*(L2_lat + miss2*(...)). Grade rel_err vs reference AMAT < 1e-9. Mac today (pure arithmetic, no timing).

rows.title: AoS counters vs line-padded SoA invalidation pair
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns modeled invalidation counts for both layouts; exact_match on the pair. Mac today.

rows.title: AoS/SoA/AoSoA winner per workload
rows.how_to_grade: For all-field vs one-field workloads, learner computes modeled bytes for each layout and returns the winner per workload; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: AoS<->SoA byte-exact round-trip
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes AoS->SoA->AoS converter on .npy fixtures; byte_exact_fraction of reconstruction must equal 1.0. Mac today.

rows.title: AoSoA tile-width optimal traffic
rows.how_to_grade: Learner models traffic(T) for AoSoA tile width T on a mixed workload and returns the minimizing T's traffic; rel_err vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Arithmetic intensity of an op (FLOPs/byte)
rows.concept: Roofline model: memory bandwidth vs compute & arithmetic intensity
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes AI = FLOPs / bytes_moved for a given op; rel_err vs reference < 1e-9. Mac today.

rows.title: Attainable FLOP/s from the roofline
rows.concept: Roofline model: memory bandwidth vs compute & arithmetic intensity
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes min(peak, BW*AI); rel_err vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Attention score matrix line traffic: pick layout
rows.how_to_grade: Given seq-len/head-dim and two QK^T score-matrix layouts, learner computes modeled DRAM line bytes for each and returns the layout that halves traffic; exact_match on choice + rel_err on byte estimate. Mac today (modeled).

rows.title: Batched embedding lookups maximize MLP
rows.how_to_grade: Learner restructures serial embedding chases into independent batched loads; harness computes modeled cycles which must meet reference (exact_match on below-reference check + value). Mac today (modeled).

rows.title: Belady OPT miss count vs LRU
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements OPT (evict furthest-next-use) and returns its miss count; exact_match vs reference (LRU count also provided for comparison). Mac today.

rows.title: Blocked cache-aware transpose misses
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes blocked transpose; exact_match on (naive_misses, blocked_misses) pair from the simulator. Mac today.

rows.title: Blocked transpose byte-exact
rows.how_to_grade: Learner's blocked transpose vs reference np transpose; byte_exact_fraction == 1.0. Mac today.

rows.title: Branchless min/max/abs/select correctness
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements branchless min/max/abs/select on int arrays; byte_exact_fraction == 1.0 vs branchy reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Branchless top-k mask for LLM sampling
rows.how_to_grade: Learner builds a branchless top-k/threshold mask over logits fixtures; argmax_agreement (and byte-exact mask) vs branchy reference == 1.0. Mac today.

rows.title: Break loop-carried dependency with N accumulators
rows.how_to_grade: Learner rewrites a reduction with N independent accumulators; max_abs_err vs serial below tol AND modeled critical path below gate. Mac today.

rows.title: Buddy allocator split/merge correctness
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements a buddy allocator; exact_match on the sequence of allocated block indices vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Bump/arena allocator: no-overlap + byte-exact
rows.how_to_grade: Learner writes a bump allocator over a byte arena; exact_match on overlap count = 0 and returned region bounds vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Byte-efficiency of a strided walk
rows.how_to_grade: For array walk with stride s and dtype width, learner computes bytes_used/bytes_fetched (fetched = lines_touched*line_size). rel_err vs reference < 1e-9. Mac today.

rows.title: Byte-exact streaming memcpy
rows.how_to_grade: Learner's streaming copy result vs source; byte_exact_fraction == 1.0. Mac today.

rows.title: Cache-line-aligned token record min footprint
rows.how_to_grade: Learner lays out a token record so hot fields are line-aligned while minimizing footprint; size_ratio vs naive below gate. Mac today.

rows.title: Cache-oblivious miss rate across 4 cache sizes
rows.how_to_grade: Learner predicts miss rate of one cache-oblivious algo (no retuning) across 4 cache sizes; rel_err on the 4-value MRC vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Cache-oblivious recursive matmul miss count
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements recursive-halving matmul; harness traces addresses and rel_err on miss count vs a tuned-tiled reference (should match within tol without knowing cache size). Mac today.

rows.title: Cache pollution from a streaming memset
rows.how_to_grade: Learner models useful lines evicted with temporal stores vs preserved with NT stores; exact_match on evicted-useful-line count for both. Mac today.

rows.title: Classify interleave vs bind benefit
rows.how_to_grade: Given access-sharing patterns, learner labels each workload interleave-favorable or bind-favorable; exact_match. Mac today (modeled).

rows.title: Classify latency plateaus to cache levels
rows.how_to_grade: 6 synthetic latency-per-access curves (.npy, modeled staircases, not measured). Learner labels each plateau L1/L2/L3/DRAM by capacity threshold; exact_match on label vector. Mac today (fixtures are modeled, so hardware-independent).

rows.title: Classify memory-bound vs compute-bound
rows.concept: Roofline model: memory bandwidth vs compute & arithmetic intensity
rows.how_to_grade: Given AI and a roofline (peak FLOP/s, BW), learner labels each op's regime; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Classify misses cold/capacity/conflict
rows.how_to_grade: Using reuse-distance + associativity model over 4 traces, learner returns per-trace (cold,capacity,conflict) counts; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Classify when to densify a gather
rows.how_to_grade: Given density + reuse, learner labels gather-vs-densify per scenario by modeled traffic; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Closed-form stride-s line count vs simulator
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements a closed form for lines fetched by a stride-s walk over n elements with L elements/line; harness checks agreement with the simulator over 20 (n,s,L) cases; exact_match on agreement count = 20. Mac today.

rows.title: Compare 4 predictors' mispredicts
rows.how_to_grade: Learner runs always-taken / 1-bit / 2-bit / gshare over one trace; exact_match on the 4-vector of mispredicts. Mac today.

rows.title: Compensated vs naive dot-product accuracy
rows.how_to_grade: Learner reports rel_err of naive vs compensated dot vs high-precision reference; grade the improvement. Mac today.

rows.title: Confirm sqrt(C) traffic-scaling law
rows.how_to_grade: Learner runs modeled DRAM traffic across a size sweep and fits the exponent of the O(n^3/sqrt(C)) law; rel_err on fitted exponent vs 3.0/scaling reference within tolerance. Mac today.

rows.title: Count total padding bytes for a record array
rows.how_to_grade: Learner sums inter-field + tail padding across N records; exact_match on padding-byte total. Mac today.

rows.title: Critical-path length of an op DAG
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture: op DAG (nodes with latencies, edges). Learner returns longest weighted path; exact_match vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Critical-word-first time-to-first-word
rows.how_to_grade: Given a line-fill model (burst order, per-word cycle), learner computes modeled cycles to the first useful word with vs without critical-word-first; rel_err vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: CSR sparse matvec vs dense reference
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements CSR SpMV; max_abs_err vs dense reference below tol on .npy fixtures. Mac today.

rows.title: Data-dependent branch to arithmetic mask
rows.how_to_grade: Learner replaces an if/else in a loop with mask arithmetic; byte_exact_fraction == 1.0 vs branchy reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Decide when NT stores help
rows.how_to_grade: Given (working set vs cache, reuse) scenarios, learner labels NT-beneficial or harmful; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Derive collision stride, verify vs simulator
rows.how_to_grade: Learner derives the minimum stride mapping consecutive accesses to one set (= num_sets*line) and harness checks agreement with the sim over cases; exact_match on agreement count. Mac today.

rows.title: Derive min padding to separate N thread-local vars
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes padding bytes per var so each occupies its own line; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Detect and count denormal-producing inputs
rows.how_to_grade: Learner counts values in the subnormal range (|x| < min_normal, x != 0) in a fixture; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Detect falsely-shared cache lines
rows.how_to_grade: Given per-thread write-address sets, a line is falsely shared if >=2 threads write distinct addresses in it. Learner returns the set of such line ids; exact_match. Mac today (fully modeled, no threads run).

rows.title: Detect fragmentation-induced OOM
rows.how_to_grade: Learner labels each request succeed/fail when largest free block < request despite sufficient total free; exact_match on labels. Mac today.

rows.title: Detect RAW/WAR/WAW hazards
rows.how_to_grade: Given an instruction list with reads/writes, learner returns (RAW,WAR,WAW) counts; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Direct-mapped vs 4-way vs full miss triple
rows.how_to_grade: Same thrashing trace through 3 associativities; learner returns miss triple; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Distinct cache lines touched
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture: .npy address trace + line size (64 x86 / 128 Apple). Learner returns count of unique (addr>>log2(line)) blocks; exact_match vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Distinct pages touched (page working set)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner counts unique VPNs in a trace; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Effect of fusion on AI and bound flip
rows.concept: Roofline model: memory bandwidth vs compute & arithmetic intensity
rows.how_to_grade: Learner recomputes AI after fusing 3 ops (fewer intermediate bytes); rel_err on fused AI + exact_match on whether the regime label flips. Mac today.

rows.title: Elements-per-register for fp32/fp16/int8
rows.concept: SIMD / vectorization (NEON on Apple, AVX on x86)
rows.how_to_grade: For 128b NEON / 256b/512b AVX register widths, learner returns lanes-per-dtype table; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Embedding gather: choose page size
rows.how_to_grade: For a scattered embedding gather learner computes TLB misses across page sizes and returns the best; exact_match on choice matching reference. Mac today (modeled).

rows.title: First-fit vs best-fit vs buddy fragmentation
rows.how_to_grade: Same op trace through 3 policies; learner returns fragmentation vector; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: First-touch page placement ownership
rows.how_to_grade: Given a first-touch access order + node-of-thread map, learner returns owning node per page; exact_match. Mac today (modeled; Apple silicon is UMA).

rows.title: Fit a roofline from modeled throughput points
rows.concept: Roofline model: memory bandwidth vs compute & arithmetic intensity
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture: (AI, attained) points. Learner fits BW (slope) and peak (plateau); rel_err on both fitted params. Mac today (fixtures are modeled, hardware-independent).

rows.title: Fix a hot struct field with large stride
rows.how_to_grade: Given a struct-stride loop, learner rewrites layout so the hot field is contiguous; harness recomputes modeled line fetches, must drop below gate. Mac today.

rows.title: Fix a power-of-two leading-dimension thrash
rows.how_to_grade: Matrix with LD = 2^k thrashes one set; learner adds stride padding; harness recounts modeled conflict misses, must drop below gate. Mac today.

rows.title: Fix a too-large tile: max B for L2
rows.how_to_grade: Given a tiled kernel whose tile spills L2, learner returns the largest B keeping residency; exact_match on corrected B (verified by sim). Mac today.

rows.title: Fix an einsum axis order to a traffic gate
rows.how_to_grade: Given an einsum-style loop iterating the wrong axis for the layout, learner reorders; modeled DRAM bytes must be below gate. Mac today.

rows.title: Fix bool-between-doubles tail padding
rows.how_to_grade: Learner reorders a struct with a bool wedged between doubles; size_ratio must hit the minimal-size gate. Mac today.

rows.title: Flush-to-zero effect on results
rows.how_to_grade: Learner applies FTZ (zero subnormals) vs exact path; max_abs_err between paths vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: FMA vs mul-then-add rounding difference
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes a*b+c via FMA (single rounding, emulated with higher precision) vs separate ops; max_abs_err/ulp difference vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Force vectorization via settrace
rows.concept: SIMD / vectorization (NEON on Apple, AVX on x86)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements an elementwise op; sys.settrace line-event count must be below a small threshold (i.e. a numpy/vectorized call, not a Python per-element loop) AND output byte-exact. Mac today.

rows.title: Force vectorized gather via settrace
rows.how_to_grade: Learner must use np.take (not a Python loop); sys.settrace line events must be below threshold AND output byte-exact vs a reference gather. Mac today.

rows.title: fp16 vs fp32 accumulation error growth
rows.how_to_grade: Learner accumulates a long reduction in fp16 vs fp32 acc; rel_err of the reported error-growth curve vs reference within tol. Mac today.

rows.title: fp32 vs fp16 lines-fetched pair
rows.how_to_grade: Same logical loop over n elements at 4B vs 2B; learner returns (lines_fp32, lines_fp16) using elements-per-line = line/width; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Free-list external fragmentation ratio
rows.how_to_grade: Learner runs a free-list allocator over an alloc/free op sequence; rel_err on external-fragmentation ratio (free bytes not in largest block / total free). Mac today.

rows.title: From-scratch SoA transform is truly elementwise
rows.how_to_grade: Learner must transform without numpy shortcuts; sys.settrace line-event count must be within tolerance of N (proving per-element loop, not a hidden vectorized call). Mac today.

rows.title: Gather via index array: distinct lines
rows.how_to_grade: Given a base array + index array, learner returns distinct lines touched by the gather; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Gather vs contiguous load modeled uop count
rows.concept: SIMD / vectorization (NEON on Apple, AVX on x86)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner computes modeled load-uop count for a gather (one uop/element or per-line) vs a contiguous vector load; exact_match on pair. Mac today.

rows.title: GEMM AI as a function of M,N,K and reuse
rows.concept: Roofline model: memory bandwidth vs compute & arithmetic intensity
rows.how_to_grade: Learner derives AI(M,N,K,tile) accounting for tile reuse; rel_err vs reference formula. Mac today.

rows.title: gshare predictor with global history
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements gshare (GHR XOR PC index into 2-bit table); exact_match on mispredict count. Mac today.

rows.title: Horizontal sum via lane reduction (byte-exact)
rows.concept: SIMD / vectorization (NEON on Apple, AVX on x86)
rows.how_to_grade: Learner reduces simulated lanes (fixed vector width) to a scalar; byte_exact vs np.sum on integer fixtures. Mac today.

rows.title: Horner FMA count + accuracy
rows.how_to_grade: Learner evaluates a degree-d polynomial via Horner; exact_match on FMA count (= d) AND max_abs_err vs reference below tol. Mac today.

rows.title: Hot/cold field split to a traffic gate
rows.how_to_grade: Learner splits a struct into hot/cold arrays so a hot loop touches minimal lines; modeled traffic below gate. Mac today.
