rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures awq_w.npy, awq_x.npy, given scale s. Learner returns X'@W' pre-quant (must equal X@W to <1e-5) and the group-int4 dequant output. Oracle applies the same transform+quant; identity sub-gate + output max_abs_err < 1e-5 vs oracle; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: AWQ scaling vs plain group int4
rows.concept: Protecting salient channels lowers output MSE vs unscaled RTN
rows.how_to_grade: Same layer. Learner returns output MSE with AWQ scaling and with plain group int4. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6 and MSE(AWQ) < MSE(plain); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Build a normalized Sylvester-Hadamard matrix
rows.concept: Recursive H_2n = [[H,H],[H,-H]] scaled by 1/sqrt(n) so H H^T = I
rows.how_to_grade: For n=2^k, learner returns the normalized H. Oracle builds the same Sylvester construction and checks H H^T = I; H matches oracle to max_abs_err < 1e-6 and the identity holds; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Cholesky inverse of the damped Hessian
rows.concept: Numerically stable H^-1 via Cholesky, the exact path GPTQ uses
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies a damped SPD H. Learner returns H^-1 computed through Cholesky (not np.linalg.inv shortcuts are allowed but must match). Oracle inverts the same H via Cholesky; max rel_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Classify E4M3 regime per value
rows.concept: Label each value as subnormal / normal / overflow-clamped / underflow-to-zero
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture fp8_x.npy. Learner returns an integer label per element. Oracle derives regimes from the E4M3 exponent/mantissa fields and the 448 / min-subnormal bounds; exact_match on labels; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Classify each value's E2M1 code
rows.concept: Which of the 8 magnitudes (+ sign) each element maps to
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture fp4_x.npy. Learner returns the signed E2M1 code index per element. Oracle builds the grid and takes nearest; exact_match on codes; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Classify which modules quantize_dynamic targets
rows.concept: Linear/LSTM get quantized; conv/embedding/etc. are skipped
rows.how_to_grade: Given a list of module type names, learner returns a 0/1 mask of which quantize_dynamic with {Linear,LSTM} converts. Oracle applies the same type set; exact_match; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Damped Hessian from calibration activations
rows.concept: H = 2 X^T X and the diagonal damping damp = percent * mean(diag(H))
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture gptq_x.npy (calibration inputs). Learner returns H and the damped diagonal at percent=0.01. Oracle recomputes 2 X^T X and the same damping; max rel_err < 1e-8 on H and on the damped diagonal; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: error term missing the H^-1[q,q] normalization
rows.concept: Diagnose a GPTQ loop that propagates raw error without dividing by the pivot
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy GPTQ omits /H^-1[q,q] in the update. Learner fixes it. Oracle runs correct GPTQ; corrected W_q matches exactly (max_abs_err over integer codes = 0) and output MSE within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: loop optimizes scale instead of zero-point
rows.concept: HQQ holds scale fixed and optimizes only z; diagnose the swapped update
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy loop updates s each iter and leaves z fixed. Learner swaps it to update z with s fixed. Oracle runs the correct HQQ; corrected W_q exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: per-tensor scale instead of per-token
rows.concept: Diagnose KV quant that uses one scale for the whole cache
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy code uses a single absmax over all tokens. Learner restores per-token (per-row) scaling. Oracle runs the correct per-token path; corrected attention output within rel_err 1e-5 and lower MSE than the buggy path; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: per-tensor scale where vector-wise is required
rows.concept: Diagnose an int8 path that uses one scalar scale instead of per-row/per-col vectors
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy matmul quantizes X and W with a single global absmax. Learner restores per-row (X) and per-col (W) scaling. Oracle runs the correct vector-wise path; corrected Y within rel_err 1e-3; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: scale applied in the wrong direction
rows.concept: Diagnose code that multiplies both X and W by s, breaking the X@W invariant
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy AWQ does X*s and W*s. Learner fixes to X/s, W*s. Oracle runs the correct transform; X'@W' matches X@W to <1e-5 and the quant output matches oracle within 1e-5; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: smoothing folded the same way into both sides
rows.concept: Diagnose a transform that multiplies both X and W by diag(s), destroying equivalence
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy code does X*s and W*s. Learner fixes X to X/s. Oracle runs the correct transform; X'@W' matches X@W to <1e-5; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: static activation scale on shifted input
rows.concept: Dynamic quant must recompute the activation scale per input; a frozen scale fails
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy code caches the first batch's activation scale. Learner makes it recompute per input. Oracle runs the correct dynamic path on a distribution-shifted batch; corrected Y within rel_err 1e-3 while the buggy path is worse; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: uniform levels instead of the NF4 codebook
rows.concept: Diagnose an NF4 dequant that assigns uniform absmax/8 levels rather than the normal quantiles
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy quantizer uses 16 evenly spaced levels and forgets per-block normalization. Learner fixes it to use the NF4 constants + per-64 absmax. Oracle runs the reference NF4 path; exact_match on the corrected 4-bit index array; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Debug: unnormalized Hadamard breaks invariance
rows.concept: Missing 1/sqrt(n) makes H H^T = nI so X@W is not preserved
rows.how_to_grade: Provided buggy code uses the raw +/-1 Hadamard. Learner adds the 1/sqrt(n) normalization. Oracle runs the correct rotation; X'@W' matches X@W to max_abs_err < 1e-5; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Decode E4M3 bit patterns to values
rows.concept: uint8 code -> fp32 via the E4M3 field layout (bias 7, subnormals, nan)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture fp8_codes.npy (uint8). Learner decodes each to fp32. Oracle builds the 256-entry value grid from the field layout; exact_match on decoded values (nan handled as nan==nan match); gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Decomposition vs naive per-tensor int8
rows.concept: Why extracting outlier columns rescues accuracy on heavy-tailed activations
rows.how_to_grade: Outlier-heavy fixture. Learner returns MSE of LLM.int8() decomposition and of naive single-scale per-tensor int8, both vs fp32. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6, and MSE(decomp) < MSE(naive); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Dequant from HQQ state
rows.concept: W = (W_q - z) * s from stored uint codes + scale + zero
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies W_q, s, z. Learner returns (W_q - z)*s. Oracle applies the same; max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Dequant-only from stored NF4 codes
rows.concept: Reconstruct the fp tensor from packed 4-bit indices + block absmax
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies nf4_idx.npy (uint8 0-15) and nf4_absmax.npy. Learner maps index->NF4 level and multiplies by the block absmax. Oracle does the same lookup+scale; max_abs_err vs oracle reconstruction < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Detect outlier feature columns (threshold 6.0)
rows.concept: Column selection: activation features whose absmax exceeds the llm_int8_threshold
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture int8_x.npy (token x hidden activation). Learner returns the sorted set of column indices with max|X[:,j]| >= 6.0. Oracle recomputes per-column absmax and thresholds identically; exact_match on the index set; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Double quantization of the block scales
rows.concept: QLoRA second-level int8 quant of the fp32 absmax array (blocksize 256, mean-subtracted) and the bit-budget it saves
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture nf4_absmax.npy. Learner subtracts the global mean, quantizes to int8 with a blocksize-256 second scale, reconstructs, and reports effective bits/param saved. Oracle runs the same two-level scheme; compares reconstructed absmax (max rel_err < 1e-5) and reported bits/param (within 0.01 of the ~0.373 the oracle computes). numpy deterministic.

rows.title: dtype range + packing factor table
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns (qmin,qmax,pack_factor) for each of qint2/4/8. Oracle computes them from the bit width (symmetric range, 8/nbits per byte); exact_match; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Dynamic activation scale + zero-point
rows.concept: Runtime asymmetric quint8 params from a batch's min/max
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture dyn_x.npy. Learner returns scale=(max-min)/255 and zero_point=round(-min/scale). Oracle recomputes; scale within rel_err 1e-8 and zero_point exact; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Dynamic int8 Linear forward
rows.concept: Per-channel symmetric int8 weight + per-tensor dynamic asymmetric uint8 activation
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures dyn_w.npy, dyn_x.npy. Learner returns Y: int8 W (per-channel absmax/127) and uint8 X (dynamic min/max, zero-point) then int matmul dequant. Oracle runs the same path; max rel_err < 1e-3; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: E4M3 vs E5M2 on the same tensor
rows.concept: Trade mantissa precision for exponent range; which format wins depends on the distribution
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture fp8_x.npy. Learner returns cast MSE for E4M3 and E5M2. Oracle builds both value grids and casts identically; each MSE within 1e-9 and the reported winner matches oracle; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Entropy (KL) calibration threshold
rows.concept: Histogram + threshold sweep minimizing KL(fp || quantized) - ORT's entropy calibrator
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture activation + fixed histogram bins + shared candidate thresholds. Learner returns the argmin threshold index. Oracle builds the same histogram, quantizes at each candidate, computes KL divergence, returns argmin; index exact and KL within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Enumerate the E4M3 value grid
rows.concept: Count representable finite values, max finite (448), min positive subnormal
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns the sorted finite value grid plus the three constants. Oracle enumerates all 256 patterns, excludes nan; exact_match on the grid and the reported max/min constants; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Error propagation through softmax
rows.concept: How per-token KV quant error maps to attention-output MSE
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures. Learner returns the attention-output MSE and the mean KV dequant error. Oracle computes both and the empirical amplification ratio; the output MSE must match within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Fast Walsh-Hadamard transform
rows.concept: Butterfly O(n log n) equal to the dense H @ x
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture rot_x.npy (len 2^k). Learner returns the FWHT (normalized). Oracle compares to the dense normalized H @ x; max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Float vs integer zero-point domains are equivalent
rows.concept: deq = scale*q + zp_float equals scale*(q - zp_int) with zp_int = -zp_float/scale
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture codes + scale + zp_float. Learner returns both reconstructions. Oracle computes zp_int and both dequants; the two reconstructions must agree to max_abs_err < 1e-6 and match oracle; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Full AutoRound loop
rows.concept: Fixed steps / lr minimizing block reconstruction MSE via SignSGD on V
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture layer + fixed hyperparams/seed. Learner returns final W_q and block MSE. Oracle runs the same deterministic loop; W_q exact, MSE within 1e-6 and <= the RTN MSE; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Full FP8 W8A8 dynamic matmul
rows.concept: Per-tensor W scale + per-token X scale, cast both to E4M3, dequant the product
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures W, X. Learner returns Y through the FP8 dynamic path. Oracle runs the same scale->cast->matmul->dequant; max rel_err < 5e-2 vs fp32 AND within 1e-4 of the oracle FP8 output; sub-gates. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Full GPTQ error compensation on a layer
rows.concept: Column-by-column quant with error propagated into not-yet-quantized columns via H^-1
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures gptq_w.npy, gptq_x.npy, fixed damp/order/grid. Learner returns W_q and layer output MSE. Oracle runs the same deterministic GPTQ in numpy; W_q must match exactly and output MSE within 1e-6 of oracle GPTQ AND strictly below the RTN MSE; sub-gates. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Full HQQ optimization loop
rows.concept: Fixed iters / lp / beta schedule with zero-point optimization, scale held fixed
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture hqq_w.npy + fixed hyperparams. Learner returns the final W_q, z and dequant. Oracle runs the same deterministic loop; codes exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Full NF4 quantize/dequantize (blocksize 64)
rows.concept: Reproduce bitsandbytes NF4: per-64 absmax normalize, nearest codebook level, 4-bit index, dequant
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture nf4_w.npy. Learner returns 4-bit index array + dequantized tensor. Oracle runs the reference NF4 path (per-64 absmax, nearest of the 16 NF4 constants, deq = level*absmax); compares indices exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6 vs bnb.functional.dequantize_4bit semantics; two sub-gates. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Generalized soft-threshold (shrinkage) operator
rows.concept: The lp<1 proximal step prox_{lp}(residual, beta) HQQ applies to the error
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture residual vector + lp=0.7, beta. Learner returns the shrinkage output. Oracle applies the same generalized soft-threshold; max_abs_err < 1e-8; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: GPTQ vs RTN output error
rows.concept: Second-order error feedback reduces layer output MSE at equal bits
rows.how_to_grade: Same layer + calibration X. Learner returns output MSE for GPTQ and for RTN. Oracle computes both deterministically; each within 1e-6, and MSE(GPTQ) < MSE(RTN); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Grid-search the per-channel scale exponent
rows.concept: Search ratio in a fixed grid; scale = s_x^ratio minimizing activation-weighted output MSE
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures awq_w.npy, awq_x.npy, shared ratio grid. Learner returns the argmin ratio index and the best output MSE. Oracle enumerates the identical grid, applies the same group-quant per candidate, returns argmin; index exact and MSE within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Group-wise RTN baseline (the thing GPTQ beats)
rows.concept: Round-to-nearest int4 with per-group absmax scales, no error feedback
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture gptq_w.npy. Learner returns W_q and dequant using per-128-group symmetric int4. Oracle does the same RTN; W_q exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Hard activation channels needing migration
rows.concept: Identify channels whose activation absmax dominates and drive int8 error
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture sq_x.npy. Learner returns channels with max|X_j| above the given threshold. Oracle recomputes and thresholds identically; exact_match; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: HQQ initialization (asymmetric group quant)
rows.concept: scale=(max-min)/(2^n-1), zero=round(-min/scale): the starting point before optimization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture hqq_w.npy, group_size=64, nbits=4. Learner returns W_q, scale, zero and dequant. Oracle computes the same asymmetric init; codes exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: HQQ vs asymmetric RTN at 4-bit
rows.concept: Robustness to outliers from the lp<1 objective
rows.how_to_grade: Outlier-heavy fixture. Learner returns reconstruction MSE for HQQ and asymmetric RTN. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6 and MSE(HQQ) <= MSE(RTN); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: imatrix-weighted scale selection
rows.concept: Pick the per-block scale minimizing sum w_i (x_i - deq_i)^2 instead of plain MSE
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture block + imatrix weights + shared scale grid. Learner returns the argmin importance-weighted scale index. Oracle sweeps the identical grid with the weighted objective; argmin exact, weighted error within 1e-6, and it differs from the plain-MSE argmin on the fixture; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Importance matrix from calibration
rows.concept: imatrix column weight = sum over tokens of activation^2 per input channel
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture gguf_x.npy (calibration activations). Learner returns the per-input-channel sum of squares. Oracle recomputes; max rel_err < 1e-8; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Int4 weight-only tinygemm quant
rows.concept: Group-wise asymmetric uint4 with scale + float-domain zero-point
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture tao_w.npy, group_size=128. Learner returns uint4 codes + scale + zero_point and the dequant. Oracle computes scale=(max-min)/15, float zero_point=min, deq=q*scale+zp; codes exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-5; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Int8 dynamic-activation int8-weight linear
rows.concept: Per-channel symmetric int8 weight, per-token dynamic symmetric int8 activation
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures tao_w.npy, tao_x.npy. Learner returns Y via per-channel int8 W and per-token int8 X. Oracle runs the same granularities; max rel_err < 1e-3 vs oracle; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: INT8 vs FP8 KV attention error
rows.concept: Same K,V,Q: which KV dtype preserves attention better
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures. Learner returns attention-output MSE for int8-KV and fp8-KV. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6 and reports the winner matching oracle; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Learned clipping range
rows.concept: Sign-gradient optimize the per-group (min,max) range scaling to cut MSE
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture + fixed steps. Learner returns the learned per-group range scalars and MSE. Oracle runs the same range optimization; range within rel_err 1e-4 and MSE within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Learned rounding vs nearest rounding
rows.concept: AutoRound's flexible rounding lowers output MSE at equal bits
rows.how_to_grade: Same layer. Learner returns output MSE for AutoRound and RTN. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6 and MSE(AutoRound) <= MSE(RTN); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Match a bits-per-weight budget to a GGUF type
rows.concept: Compute the exact bpw of each type from its block layout and pick the fit
rows.how_to_grade: Given a target bpw, learner returns the GGUF type (Q2_K/Q4_K_M/Q6_K/Q8_0) whose computed bpw is nearest. Oracle computes each type's bpw from its block byte layout and takes argmin |bpw-target|; exact match; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Math-equivalent smoothing transform
rows.concept: X' = X/diag(s), W' = diag(s)W leaves X@W unchanged
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures + s. Learner returns X'@W'. Oracle computes the same; X'@W' must match X@W to max_abs_err < 1e-5; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Migrated quantization difficulty
rows.concept: Per-channel max/mean ratio of activations drops after smoothing
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures. Learner returns the per-channel (max|X|/mean|X|) ratio before and after smoothing. Oracle recomputes both; ratio vectors within rel_err 1e-6 and the post-smooth peak ratio < pre-smooth; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: min/max vs percentile vs entropy calibration
rows.concept: Three calibrators on a heavy-tailed activation
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture heavy-tailed activation. Learner returns reconstruction MSE for min/max, 99.99% percentile, and entropy calibration. Oracle computes all three identically and the argmin; each MSE within 1e-6 and the reported argmin matches; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Mixed-precision memory accounting
rows.concept: Effective bytes and size ratio when a given fraction of columns stay fp16
rows.how_to_grade: Given hidden dim H and the outlier column count k, learner returns bytes = (H-k)*1 + k*2 per row-group and the size_ratio vs fp16 (2*H). Oracle recomputes from the same k; rel_err < 1e-9 on the ratio; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Mixed-precision outlier decomposition
rows.concept: Y = deq(X8 @ W8) + X_outlier_fp16 @ W_outlier_fp16 over the extracted columns
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures with a few large-magnitude columns. Learner splits X into outlier(fp16)+rest(int8), computes the two matmuls and sums. Oracle runs the identical decomposition and a pure-int8 baseline; learner Y must match oracle within rel_err 1e-4 AND be closer to the fp32 reference than the pure-int8 baseline; two sub-gates. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: MXFP4 E8M0 power-of-two block scale
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture mx_w.npy. Learner returns the per-32-block E8M0 exponent. Oracle recomputes floor(log2(amax/6)); exact_match on the integer exponents; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: MXFP4 full block quantization
rows.concept: 32-elem block, E8M0 scale, E2M1 elements: quant + dequant
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture mx_w.npy. Learner returns block scales, E2M1 codes and dequant. Oracle runs the same MXFP4 path; scales exact (pow2) and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Nearest-rounding baseline (V=0)
rows.concept: Group asymmetric int4 with the rounding perturbation disabled
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture ar_w.npy. Learner returns W_q + dequant with V=0. Oracle runs the same RTN; codes exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: NF4 beats symmetric INT4 on normal weights
rows.concept: Non-uniform NormalFloat vs uniform absmax/7 int4 reconstruction error
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture nf4_w.npy (near-Gaussian weight). Learner quantizes with NF4 and with symmetric int4 (absmax/7, levels -8..7), returns both reconstruction MSEs. Oracle computes both identically; each MSE must match within 1e-9 and the ordering MSE(NF4) < MSE(int4) must hold; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: NVFP4 second-level scale factorization
rows.concept: Given the per-tensor scale, derive the per-block E4M3 scale so blocks fit the E2M1 range
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture nv_w.npy + per-tensor scale. Learner returns the per-16-block E4M3 scales. Oracle computes block-absmax/(6*per-tensor scale) then casts to E4M3; max rel_err < 1e-4; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: NVFP4 two-level scaling
rows.concept: Per-tensor fp32 scale + per-16-element E4M3 block scale + E2M1 elements
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture nv_w.npy. Learner returns the per-tensor scale, per-16 E4M3 block scales, codes and dequant. Oracle runs the same two-level path; reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: NVFP4 vs MXFP4 accuracy
rows.concept: Finer 16-elem E4M3 scales beat 32-elem pow2 scales
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture shared weight. Learner returns RMSE for NVFP4 and MXFP4. Oracle implements both and returns both RMSEs; each within 1e-6 and RMSE(NVFP4) < RMSE(MXFP4); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: One half-quadratic iteration
rows.concept: Shrink the residual, then update the zero-point z as the group-mean of (W_q - W_e' - W/s)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures init state (W_q, s, z) + lp, beta. Learner returns z and W_q after one step. Oracle runs the same update; max_abs_err < 1e-8 on z and exact W_q; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: One OBQ single-weight Hessian update
rows.concept: Quantize the min-OBS-cost weight, update the rest by -q_err * H^-1[:,q]/H^-1[q,q]
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures W row, H^-1, int4 grid. Learner performs one exact OBS step and returns the full updated weight vector. Oracle applies the closed-form update on the same inputs; max_abs_err < 1e-8; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: One SignSGD rounding step
rows.concept: V -= lr * sign(grad), clamp to [-0.5,0.5], re-quantize
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures V, gradient, lr. Learner returns updated V and W_q. Oracle applies the same signed step + clamp + requant; V max_abs_err < 1e-8 and W_q exact; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Outlier ratio before/after rotation
rows.concept: Max-to-rms activation ratio drops under the Hadamard rotation
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture rot_x.npy. Learner returns the per-channel max/rms ratio before and after X H^T. Oracle recomputes both; ratios within rel_err 1e-6 and post-rotation peak < pre; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-64 block absmax scales
rows.concept: Blockwise absmax normalization constant that NF4 stores per 64-element block
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture nf4_w.npy (real Linear weight). Learner reshapes to (-1,64) and returns the per-block absmax scale vector. Oracle recomputes absmax over the identical (-1,64) reshape; compare scale vectors by max rel_err; gate < 1e-6. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-channel smoothing scale vector
rows.concept: s_j = max(|X_j|)^alpha / max(|W_j|)^(1-alpha) at a given alpha
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures sq_x.npy, sq_w.npy, alpha=0.5. Learner returns the smoothing vector s. Oracle recomputes per-channel maxima and s identically; max rel_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-input-channel activation importance
rows.concept: s_x = mean(|X|) over tokens, the salience signal AWQ scales from
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture awq_x.npy. Learner returns the per-input-channel mean(|X|) vector. Oracle recomputes over the token axis; max rel_err < 1e-8; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-tensor and per-token FP8 scales
rows.concept: scale = absmax/448 per tensor and dynamic per-token scales (FP8_DYNAMIC)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures W and X. Learner returns the per-tensor W scale and per-token X scales. Oracle recomputes absmax/448 at each granularity; max rel_err < 1e-8; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-tensor vs per-channel weight int8
rows.concept: Per-channel weight scales cut error vs a single tensor scale
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture dyn_w.npy. Learner returns reconstruction MSE for per-tensor and per-channel int8. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-9 and MSE(per-channel) < MSE(per-tensor); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-token FP8 (E4M3) KV quant + attention error
rows.concept: FP8 cast of K,V with per-token scale then attention
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures Q,K,V. Learner returns the FP8-KV attention output and MSE. Oracle scales per-token by absmax/448, casts to the E4M3 grid, dequants and runs attention; output within rel_err 1e-4 and MSE matches; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-token INT8 KV quant + attention error
rows.concept: Per-row absmax int8 on K and V, dequant, run SDPA, measure output MSE vs fp32
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures Q,K,V. Learner returns the attention output through the int8 KV path and its MSE. Oracle quantizes KV per-token identically, runs the same softmax(QK^T/sqrt d)V; output within rel_err 1e-5 and MSE matches; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Per-token scales + memory accounting
rows.concept: Per-row absmax scales for K and V and the 2x size ratio vs fp16
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures K,V. Learner returns per-token scales and the KV size_ratio (int8 vs fp16). Oracle recomputes; scales within rel_err 1e-8 and size_ratio within 1e-9; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Percentile clipping sweep
rows.concept: Choose the clip percentile minimizing MSE (ORT percentile calibrator)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture + shared percentile grid. Learner returns the argmin percentile index and MSE. Oracle sweeps the identical grid, clips and quantizes at each, returns argmin; index exact and MSE within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Pick the int4 group_size
rows.concept: Smaller groups cut error but add scale-storage bits; choose the min-cost group_size
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture W, candidate group_sizes {32,64,128,256}. Learner returns the argmin group_size under (reconstruction MSE + scale-overhead bpw penalty) and the score. Oracle evaluates the same cost per candidate; argmin exact and score within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Pick the KV scale granularity
rows.concept: per-tensor vs per-token vs per-head minimizing attention MSE under a scale-storage budget
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures + the three granularities. Learner returns the argmin granularity under (attention MSE + scale-storage penalty). Oracle evaluates the same cost per option; argmin exact and score within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Q4_0 block pack/unpack (32-elem, fp16 scale)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture gguf_w.npy. Learner returns nibbles + dequant per 32-block. Oracle runs the exact ggml Q4_0 quantize_row/dequantize_row; nibbles exact and reconstruction within 1e-3 relative (fp16 scale precision); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Q4_0 vs Q8_0 reconstruction error
rows.concept: Bits-per-weight vs quality on the same block set
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture gguf_w.npy. Learner returns reconstruction MSE for Q4_0 and Q8_0. Oracle computes both ggml paths; each within 1e-6 and MSE(Q8_0) < MSE(Q4_0); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Q4_K super-block structure
rows.concept: 256 super-block = 8 sub-blocks of 32; 6-bit sub-scales+mins under a super-scale d/dmin; 4-bit asym quants
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture gguf_sb.npy (multiple of 256). Learner returns the 8 sub-scales, 8 sub-mins, packed 4-bit quants, and dequant. Oracle runs the exact ggml Q4_K path; reconstruction within 1e-3 relative and the 6-bit scale/min codes exact; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Q6_K dequant from packed fields
rows.concept: Reconstruct fp from ql (low4), qh (high2), 8-bit sub-scales, super d
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies ql, qh, scales, d for a 256 super-block. Learner returns the dequantized values via the exact Q6_K formula. Oracle applies the same reconstruction; within 1e-3 relative; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Q8_0 block quantization (32-elem, int8)
rows.concept: d = amax/127, q = round(x/d), deq = q*d per 32-element block
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture gguf_w.npy. Learner returns int8 codes + dequant. Oracle runs the ggml Q8_0 math; codes exact and reconstruction within 1e-3 relative; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: qfloat8 weight quant (per-tensor scale + E4M3)
rows.concept: Compose per-tensor scaling with an FP8 cast
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture qnt_w.npy. Learner returns per-tensor scale, the E4M3-cast codes and dequant. Oracle scales by absmax/448, casts to the E4M3 value grid, dequants; reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-4; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: qint4 per-axis vs per-group scales
rows.concept: Finer granularity trades storage for lower error
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture qnt_w.npy. Learner returns reconstruction MSE for per-axis and per-group qint4. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-9 and MSE(per-group) < MSE(per-axis); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: qint4 / qint2 sub-byte packing
rows.concept: Pack multiple symmetric low-bit codes into one uint8 and unpack
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture qnt_w.npy. Learner returns the packed uint8 buffer for qint4 (2/byte) and qint2 (4/byte) plus dequant. Oracle quantizes symmetric and packs with the same bit order; byte_exact_fraction of the packed buffer == 1.0 and dequant max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: qint8 per-axis symmetric quant
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture qnt_w.npy, axis=0. Learner returns int8 codes + per-channel scale + dequant. Oracle computes per-axis absmax/127 symmetric; codes exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: QuantizeLinear / DeQuantizeLinear round-trip
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture onnx_x.npy + given scale, zp. Learner returns the QDQ round-trip tensor and the uint8 codes. Oracle applies the exact QuantizeLinear/DeQuantizeLinear op semantics; codes exact and reconstruction max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Random Hadamard vs learned orthogonal rotation
rows.concept: A learned R can beat a fixed Hadamard at W4A4 (SpinQuant)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures + a provided learned orthogonal R. Learner returns W4A4 output MSE under Hadamard and under R. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6 and MSE(R) <= MSE(Hadamard); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Reconstruct from NVFP4 storage
rows.concept: Combine per-tensor fp32 scale, E4M3 block scales, E2M1 codes into fp
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies the three stored arrays. Learner returns deq = per_tensor * e4m3_block * e2m1_value. Oracle applies the same product; max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Reconstruct from QDQ node params
rows.concept: deq = (q - zp) * s from stored uint8 codes
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies uint8 codes, scale, zp. Learner returns the dequantized tensor. Oracle applies DeQuantizeLinear; max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Reconstruct from tinygemm codes
rows.concept: Float zero-point-domain dequant from packed uint4 + scale + zp
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies uint4 codes, scale, zero_point. Learner returns deq = q*scale + zero_point. Oracle applies the same float-domain formula; max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Reconstruct the dynamic Linear output
rows.concept: From int8 weight + weight scale + activation scale/zp
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies int8 W, weight scales, activation scale/zp and the uint8 activations. Learner returns the dequantized Y. Oracle applies the same dequant matmul; max rel_err < 1e-4; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: reduce_range accumulator safety
rows.concept: Halving activation qmax to 63 avoids int32 overflow on some backends
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures + a worst-case accumulation. Learner returns Y for full-range (qmax 127) and reduce_range (qmax 63) uint8 and the peak int32 accumulator per column. Oracle recomputes; both outputs within rel_err 1e-3 of oracle and the reduce_range peak below the stated bound; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Rotation preserves the matmul, spreads outliers
rows.concept: W' = H W, X' = X H^T keeps X@W invariant while flattening activation peaks
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures X,W. Learner returns X'@W' (must equal X@W to <1e-5), plus int4-quant MSE rotated and unrotated. Oracle builds the same H, quantizes both paths identically; invariance sub-gate + MSE(rotated) matches and < MSE(unrotated); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Simulate E4M3 round-to-nearest-even cast
rows.concept: Snap fp32 to the nearest representable E4M3 value incl. subnormals, clamp finite max 448
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture fp8_x.npy spanning subnormals/overflow. Learner returns the cast values. Oracle enumerates all 256 E4M3 bit patterns -> value grid, does nearest-even snap with clamp at 448; exact_match on the cast tensor; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Smoothed vs raw W8A8 output error
rows.concept: Migration makes per-tensor int8 activations quantizable
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures. Learner returns per-tensor W8A8 output MSE smoothed and raw. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6 and MSE(smoothed) < MSE(raw); gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Snap normalized weights to the NF4 codebook
rows.concept: Nearest-neighbour assignment onto the 16 fixed NormalFloat quantile levels
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture nf4_norm.npy of fp32 values already in [-1,1]. Learner returns the uint8 index (0-15) of the nearest of the 16 canonical NF4 levels. Oracle builds the same NF4 codebook constant, computes argmin |v - level|, exact_match on the index array; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic, no timing.

rows.title: Snap to the E2M1 (FP4) value grid
rows.method: Microscaling FP4 - NVFP4 / MXFP4 block quantization
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture fp4_x.npy already scaled into range. Learner snaps each value to the nearest signed E2M1 level. Oracle builds the same 8-magnitude grid and snaps; max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Static min/max calibration params
rows.concept: Per-tensor asymmetric quint8 scale + zero-point from observed min/max
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture calibration tensor. Learner returns scale=(max-min)/255 and zp=round(-min/scale) (clamped). Oracle recomputes; scale within rel_err 1e-8 and zp exact; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Straight-through gradient of block MSE wrt V
rows.concept: The STE gradient the SignSGD optimizer consumes
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures ar_w.npy, ar_x.npy, current V. Learner returns the STE gradient of ||X W - X deq(W_q(V))||^2 wrt V. Oracle recomputes the same STE gradient; max rel_err < 1e-5; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Symmetric vs Asymmetric INT8 Quantization and Dequantization
Symmetric weights vs asymmetric activations
rows.concept: ORT default: qint8 zp=0 for weights, quint8 zp!=0 for activations
rows.how_to_grade: Given a set of tensors tagged weight/activation, learner returns (qmin,qmax,is_symmetric) per tensor under ORT defaults. Oracle applies the same rule (weights signed symmetric, activations unsigned asymmetric); exact_match on the triples; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: The two torchao scale granularities
rows.concept: Per-output-channel weight scales vs per-token activation scales
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures W, X. Learner returns per-channel W scales and per-token X scales. Oracle recomputes both; max rel_err < 1e-8; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Top-1% salient channels
rows.concept: Selecting the channels whose activation magnitude makes their weights salient
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture awq_x.npy. Learner returns the index set of the top-1% channels by mean(|X|). Oracle recomputes and takes the same top-k (ceil(0.01*C)); exact_match on the set; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Tune the migration strength alpha
rows.concept: Sweep alpha in [0,1] and pick the one minimizing W8A8 output MSE
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures + shared alpha grid. Learner returns argmin alpha index and MSE. Oracle sweeps the identical grid, recomputing s and the int8 output per alpha; index exact and MSE within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Undo rotation on stored weights
rows.concept: Recover W = H^T W' from the rotated-and-quantized weight
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies W' and H. Learner returns H^T @ W'. Oracle applies the same inverse rotation; max_abs_err < 1e-5 vs the original-space dequant; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Unpack + dequant qint4 codes
rows.concept: Recover fp from packed nibbles + per-axis scale
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture supplies packed nibbles + scale. Learner unpacks and dequantizes. Oracle applies the same unpack+scale; max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Vector-wise int8 matmul reconstruction
rows.concept: Quantize X per-row and W per-col to int8, accumulate int32, dequant by the outer product of scales
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures int8_x.npy, int8_w.npy (no strong outliers). Learner returns Y = dequant(round(X/sx) @ round(W/sw)) with the scale outer product. Oracle runs the same vector-wise path; max rel_err < 1e-3 vs the oracle int8 output; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Vector-wise int8 scales for X and W
rows.concept: Per-row activation scale and per-column weight scale (absmax/127) used by the int8 GEMM
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures int8_x.npy, int8_w.npy. Learner returns per-row X scales and per-column W scales (absmax/127). Oracle recomputes both; max rel_err < 1e-6 on each vector; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Weight-clipping search after scaling
rows.concept: Grid-search a per-group clip ratio that further minimizes MSE (AutoAWQ's clip step)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures + shared clip-ratio grid. Learner returns per-group argmin clip index and MSE. Oracle sweeps the identical grid post-scaling; clip indices exact_match and MSE within 1e-6; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Weight-only vs dynamic-activation error
rows.concept: int8 weight-only keeps activations high precision; int8-dynamic quantizes both
rows.how_to_grade: Same layer. Learner returns output MSE for int8-weight-only and int8-dynamic. Oracle computes both; each within 1e-6 and reports which is lower matching oracle; gate. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: Which weights flipped rounding direction
rows.concept: Classify per-weight up vs down vs nearest after the learned V
rows.how_to_grade: Fixtures W and learned V. Learner returns per-weight label: rounds up/down and whether it differs from nearest. Oracle recomputes round(W/s + V) vs round(W/s); exact_match on labels; gate 1.0. numpy deterministic.

rows.title: 1D Wasserstein via CDF integral
rows.concept: Sorted-diff equals ∫|F_t - F_s|; handle unequal lengths
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = two distributions of unequal support. Learner returns W1 via the inverse-CDF/quantile integral. Oracle = scipy-style W1 on the same. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Activation-based importance scoring
rows.concept: Score heads/neurons/channels by mean |activation| over calibration
rows.method: Minitron pipeline — width+depth prune then distill
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-structure activations over a calibration batch. Learner returns the importance vector (mean abs activation, aggregated per structure). Oracle recomputes. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Activation covariance & eigenbasis
rows.concept: C = E[xxᵀ], eigvecs Q sorted by eigenvalue
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = activation matrix X. Learner returns C and its eigenvectors/eigenvalues sorted descending. Oracle = np.linalg.eigh on X.T@X/n. Grade eigenvalues rel_err<1e-8 AND eigenvectors match up to sign; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Activation-weighted 2:4 mask
rows.concept: Top-2 per group by |W|*||X|| beats plain magnitude on WX
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X. Learner returns the 2:4 mask maximizing kept |W|*colnorm(X) per group AND the resulting ||WX-(W⊙M)X||_F^2. Oracle recomputes both this and the plain-magnitude 2:4 mse. Grade mse within tol AND weighted <= magnitude; gate ordering + values.

rows.title: Angular distance per layer
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-layer states. Learner returns angular distance per layer. Oracle = arccos(clipped cos)/pi. Grade max_abs_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Angular-distance vs Block-Influence agreement
rows.concept: Do the two importance signals rank layers the same?
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-layer states. Learner returns both rankings and their Spearman correlation. Oracle recomputes both. Grade both orders == oracle AND Spearman value within 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Best contiguous n-block to drop
rows.concept: argmin over start index of mean angular distance x_ℓ→x_{ℓ+n}
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = hidden states at every layer boundary + block size n. Learner returns the start layer whose n-block deletion has min angular distance. Oracle sweeps all starts. Grade argmin_index == oracle for each n AND distances match<1e-6; gate exact.

rows.title: Block Influence layer ranking
rows.concept: BI_i = 1 - E[cos(x_in,x_out)]; rank layers by removability
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-layer in/out states. Learner returns BI per layer and the ranking. Oracle recomputes BI and sorts. Grade BI rel_err<1e-6 AND ranking order == oracle; gate Spearman==1.0.

rows.title: Cached-norm sparsity sweep
rows.concept: Reuse one activation-norm pass across many target sparsities
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X + a list of sparsities [0.3,0.5,0.7]. Learner computes norms once and returns the per-row Wanda mask for each s. Oracle recomputes each independently. Grade every mask == oracle; gate all IoU==1.0.

rows.title: Classify a mask as valid 2:4
rows.concept: Every group of 4 along the reduction dim has exactly 2 nonzeros
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a candidate mask reshaped to (...,4). Learner returns per-group validity + overall bool. Oracle checks each 4-group sums to 2. Grade exact_match of the verdict vector; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Classify ALM token-pair alignment type
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student token-string pairs. Learner labels each pair. Oracle applies the exact/substring/none rule. Grade exact_match of the labels; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Classify & apply on-policy vs off-policy target
rows.concept: Route each token to the correct teacher target
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-token source tags (student-rollout vs dataset) + both target sets. Learner returns which target applies per token and the routed loss inputs. Oracle recomputes. Grade exact_match of the routing; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Classify constraint satisfaction
rows.concept: Does a candidate mask hit the exact target architecture?
rows.method: Sheared-LLaMA — targeted structured pruning + dynamic batch loading
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = candidate mask + target (L,H,d_ff). Learner returns bool. Oracle counts survivors per axis and compares to target. Grade exact_match; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Classify k for a variance target
rows.concept: Smallest k with cumulative variance >= target
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = eigenvalue spectrum + target (e.g. 0.95). Learner returns the minimal k. Oracle = argmin k where cumsum(λ)/Σλ >= target. Grade argmin_index == oracle; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Classify removable vs critical layers
rows.concept: Threshold BI to split the block set
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-layer BI + a threshold. Learner returns the removable set. Oracle = {i: BI_i < thr}. Grade exact_match of the set; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Classify the coupling map of an attention block
rows.concept: Which tensors must be cut together when a head is removed
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = q/k/v/o_proj shapes + a head index. Learner returns which rows/cols of each tensor the head owns. Oracle = the DepGraph coupling (q/k/v output slice + o_proj input slice). Grade exact_match of the index map; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Classify whether a mask is a valid L1-unstructured mask at s
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W plus a candidate boolean mask M and target amount s. Oracle builds the true L1 mask (keep largest (1-s)*n by |w|, torch.topk tie order via stable argsort) and returns whether M equals it. Grade exact_match of the yes/no verdict; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Combined logit+intermediate loss and its gradient
rows.method: Minitron pipeline — width+depth prune then distill
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student logits + hidden + β. Learner returns L and dL w.r.t. student logits & hidden. Oracle finite-differences the same L. Grade grad max_abs_err<1e-5; gate matches FD.

rows.title: Combined served size
rows.concept: int4 values on nonzeros + 2-bit indices + fp16 scales
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = 2:4+int4 weight + group size. Learner returns total bytes and size_ratio vs fp16 dense. Oracle = nnz*0.5B + 2-bit meta + scales. Grade size_ratio within 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Compressed-sparse storage size vs dense
rows.concept: Bitmask+values footprint of an unstructured-pruned tensor
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = pruned fp16 weight. Learner reports bytes for (1-bit mask + fp16 nonzeros) and size_ratio vs dense fp16. Oracle computes nnz*2 + ceil(n/8) bytes and the ratio. Grade size_ratio within 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Compute-savings from the chosen width/depth
rows.concept: Param ratio of the pruned shell vs the teacher
rows.method: Minitron pipeline — width+depth prune then distill
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher layer shapes + chosen width/depth keep-sets. Learner returns the pruned param count and ratio vs teacher. Oracle recomputes across all coupled tensors + dropped layers. Grade size_ratio within 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Compute Wanda per-input activation norms
rows.concept: Column L2 norm ||X_{:,j}||_2 over the calibration set
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = calibration activation matrix X (n_tokens x d_in) for one Linear. Learner returns the per-column L2 norm vector. Oracle = np.linalg.norm(X,axis=0). Grade rel_err < 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Cosine-annealed update fraction
rows.concept: f_t = f0/2·(1+cos(π t/T)); regrown count at step t
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = f0, T, step t, live count. Learner returns the number of connections updated at t. Oracle = round(f_t · nnz). Grade exact_match integer; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Cosine similarity of one layer's in/out states
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = hidden states before/after one block (n_tokens x d). Learner returns mean per-token cosine. Oracle = mean(cos over tokens). Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Count live params & sparsity of a mask
rows.concept: Density accounting of a sparse tensor
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a sparse mask. Learner returns live count and sparsity. Oracle = mask.sum() / mask.size. Grade exact_match; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Dark-knowledge vs hard-label gradient
rows.concept: Soft targets carry inter-class info a one-hot label omits
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture where teacher's non-argmax probs are informative. Learner returns the student-logit gradient under KD and under hard-label CE. Oracle recomputes both; asserts they point differently (cosine<1). Grade grads match oracle within 1e-6; gate matches + direction differs.

rows.title: Debug a broken OBS update
rows.concept: Forgetting the /[H⁻¹]_qq divisor or the sign
rows.how_to_grade: Provided update omits the 1/[Hinv]_qq scaling (or flips sign), so reconstruction is worse than magnitude. Fix to the correct OBS formula. Oracle = correct numpy SparseGPT. Grade reconstruction rel_err < 1e-5 vs oracle; gate matches.

rows.title: Debug a globally-thresholded Wanda
rows.concept: Per-output-row comparison, not one global top-k
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Provided code ranks S globally (or uses mean instead of L2 norm), giving uneven per-row sparsity. Fix to per-row top-k with the L2 norm. Oracle = correct per-row Wanda mask. Grade mask == oracle; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Debug a half-coupled head prune
rows.concept: Slicing q_proj but forgetting the o_proj input columns
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Provided code slices q/k/v but leaves o_proj full → shape mismatch / wrong output. Fix to also slice o_proj input. Oracle = correct pruned forward. Grade output max_abs_err<1e-6 vs oracle; gate matches.

rows.title: Debug a pipeline that quantizes the pruned zeros
rows.concept: Zeros polluting the group absmax / wasting codes
rows.how_to_grade: Provided compound code includes the 2:4-dropped zeros when computing the per-group absmax scale, inflating it. Fix to scale from survivors only. Oracle = correct compound weight. Grade max_abs_err<tol vs oracle; gate matches.

rows.title: Debug a RigL that regrows among live weights
rows.concept: Growing into already-live positions or by |w| not |grad|
rows.how_to_grade: Provided grow step samples among ALL positions (double-counting live) or ranks by |w|. Fix to top-|grad| among zeros only. Oracle = correct mask. Grade mask == oracle AND count conserved; gate exact.

rows.title: Debug a T²-less / softmax(z*T) KD
rows.concept: Missing T² or multiplying instead of dividing by T
rows.how_to_grade: Provided KD omits T² (gradient collapses) or uses softmax(z*T). Fix to the correct DistilBERT form. Oracle = correct loss+grad. Grade both rel_err<1e-6 vs oracle; gate matches.

rows.title: Debug a wrong-order eigenvector slice
rows.concept: Slicing the LARGEST components (ascending sort bug)
rows.how_to_grade: Provided code sorts eigenvalues ascending and keeps the top-k of that (the smallest), maximizing error. Fix to keep the largest-eigenvalue directions. Oracle = min-error projection. Grade projection error == oracle min<1e-8; gate matches.

rows.title: Debug an unclamped-arccos / max-distance selector
rows.concept: cos slightly >1 → NaN, or dropping max instead of min
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Provided selector arccos's an unclamped cosine (NaN) and/or picks the MAX-distance block. Fix to clip then argmin. Oracle = correct min-distance block. Grade selected start == oracle; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Debug tie-handling in a magnitude prune
rows.concept: Correct >= vs > and duplicate-|w| boundary against torch.topk order
rows.how_to_grade: Provided prune uses a value threshold (`|w|>thr`) that over/under-prunes when many weights tie at the threshold magnitude. Oracle = torch.topk-order keep-set (stable). Fix to keep exactly (1-s)*n. Grade mask == oracle; gate 1.0.

rows.title: DeepSparse-style CSR matmul (unstructured)
rows.concept: CSR sparse matmul equals dense masked matmul
rows.method: Sparse inference serving (2:4 sparse + quant kernels)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = an unstructured-pruned weight in CSR (indptr/indices/data) + X. Learner computes Y via CSR. Oracle = (W⊙M)@X. Grade max_abs_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: DepGraph group-norm importance ranking
rows.concept: Aggregate importance over a whole coupled group before ranking
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = coupled tensors of several prunable groups. Learner returns the group ranking by the L2 group norm across ALL coupled weights. Oracle recomputes. Grade ranking (order) == oracle; gate Spearman==1.0.

rows.title: Derive greedy top-2 optimality over the 6 patterns
rows.concept: Exhaustive 6-pattern search equals greedy per group
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W. Learner returns, per 4-group, the dropped-|w| minimum found by brute force over all 6 valid 2:4 patterns. Oracle = same exhaustive min. Grade minimal dropped Σ|w| == oracle within 1e-9 AND equals greedy top-2; gate exact.

rows.title: Derive per-row scale invariance of the Wanda mask
rows.concept: Scaling an output row of W leaves that row's keep-set unchanged
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X + random positive per-row scales c. Learner returns the Wanda mask of diag(c)@W. Oracle proves/recomputes it equals the mask of W (ranking within a row is scale-invariant). Grade mask == oracle mask of W; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Derive the s-quantile threshold matching argsort mask
rows.concept: Quantile threshold identical to top-k keep-set even with duplicates
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W with many duplicate magnitudes + s. Learner returns the threshold and mask via np.quantile(|w|,s) then a documented tie-break by flat index so it equals the argsort top-k mask. Oracle = argsort keep-set. Grade mask == oracle; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Derive the T→∞ MSE limit
rows.concept: T²·KL → ½·MSE(logits) up to a constant
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = logits + a grid of growing T. Learner returns T²·KL and the ½·||z_t - z_s||² limit (mean-subtracted). Oracle recomputes. Grade rel_err of the two shrinks below tol as T grows; gate limit matches oracle.

rows.title: Detect a 2:4 sparse tensor
rows.concept: Auto-detect the semi-structured pattern from a checkpoint
rows.method: Sparse inference serving (2:4 sparse + quant kernels)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = several weights (some 2:4, some dense, some unstructured). Learner returns a per-tensor bool: is it valid 2:4? Oracle checks every 4-group has exactly 2 nonzeros. Grade exact_match; gate 1.0.

rows.title: DistilBERT KD loss
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student logits + labels + (α,T). Learner returns L. Oracle recomputes in numpy. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Drop step: prune bottom-|w| of live weights
rows.concept: Remove the smallest-magnitude fraction of currently live weights
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = weights + current mask + drop fraction. Learner returns the post-drop mask. Oracle removes the bottom-|w| live weights. Grade mask == oracle; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Dynamic batch-loading weight update
rows.concept: Reweight domains ∝ exp(η·excess loss), renormalize to simplex
rows.method: Sheared-LLaMA — targeted structured pruning + dynamic batch loading
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = prior domain weights + excess losses + η. Learner returns updated weights (exponentiated-gradient / softmax update, sum to 1). Oracle recomputes. Grade rel_err<1e-6 AND Σ==1; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Effective bits per weight
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a compound config (2:4 density, int4, group size). Learner returns effective bits/weight. Oracle = (density·4 + index/scale overhead)/1. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Enumerate & classify the 6 valid 2:4 patterns
rows.concept: Map a 4-bit keep-vector to its pattern index (or invalid)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = list of 4-bit vectors. Learner returns the pattern index in the canonical 6-pattern table (or -1). Oracle builds the C(4,2)=6 table and looks up. Grade exact_match argmin_index; gate 1.0.

rows.title: ERK per-layer density budget
rows.concept: Erdős–Rényi-Kernel sparsity allocation to a global budget
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-layer shapes + global density. Learner returns the ERK per-layer density vector. Oracle applies the ERK proportional rule and renormalizes to the global budget. Grade rel_err<1e-6 AND global mean matches; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Error-compounding triangle bound
rows.concept: Compound error ≤ prune error + quant error
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X. Learner returns the compound reconstruction error and the two individual (prune-only, quant-only) errors. Oracle recomputes. Grade compound <= prune+quant within numerical tol AND the three values match oracle; gate bound holds.

rows.title: Excess-loss signal for dynamic batch loading
rows.method: Sheared-LLaMA — targeted structured pruning + dynamic batch loading
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-domain current losses + reference losses. Learner returns the excess-loss vector. Oracle = current - reference. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Expected sparsity & retained magnitude of a pattern distribution
rows.concept: Aggregate over the 6-pattern probabilities per group
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-group distribution over the 6 patterns + weights. Learner returns expected density and expected retained Σ|w|. Oracle = Σ_k p_k · (pattern density / retained). Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Form the SparseGPT Hessian and its inverse
rows.concept: H = 2 X Xᵀ + λI and H⁻¹ via Cholesky
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = calibration X for one Linear + damping λ. Learner returns H and H⁻¹. Oracle = 2*X@X.T + λ*I then np.linalg.inv (or cho_solve). Grade max_abs_err of H and H⁻¹ < 1e-8; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Forward vs reverse KL KD term
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student logits + T. Learner returns both KL directions. Oracle recomputes. Grade both rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Full 1D optimal transport with a ground metric
rows.concept: OT cost with cost |i-j| via sort + cumulative
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = two mass vectors + a 1D ground metric. Learner returns the OT cost via the cumulative-difference formula. Oracle = a small LP / POT reference. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Full column-block prune + OBS compensation
rows.concept: Unstructured SparseGPT: mask + weight update per column block
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = deterministic W,X,s. Oracle = pure-numpy SparseGPT (Hessian, Cholesky, per-column mask by w²/[Hinv]_qq, propagate correction to remaining columns). Grade ||WX-ŴX||_F rel_err vs oracle < 1e-5; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Full RigL topology update
rows.concept: drop(bottom-|w|) then grow(top-|grad|) at fixed density
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = w, dense g, current mask, update fraction. Learner returns the new mask. Oracle applies drop then grow deterministically. Grade mask == oracle AND live count conserved; gate exact.

rows.title: General N:M mask (4:8, 1:4)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = weight + (N,M). Oracle = per-M-group top-N by |w|. Grade mask == oracle AND every M-group has exactly N survivors AND dropped Σ|w| == oracle min; gate exact.

rows.title: Generalized JSD(β) divergence
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = distributions p,q + β. Learner returns JSD_β. Oracle recomputes. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: GKD mixed on/off-policy objective
rows.concept: λ-weighted mix of student-rollout and data targets
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-token targets tagged on-policy/off-policy + λ + student logits. Learner returns the expected mixed loss. Oracle recomputes with the same routing. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Global_unstructured across layers with one shared threshold
rows.concept: One magnitude threshold compared ACROSS tensors of different scale
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = list of 4 layer weights with different scales + global amount s. Oracle concatenates all |w|, finds the single global kth threshold, masks each layer. Grade per-layer masks == oracle AND global sparsity == s within 1 element; gate exact.

rows.title: Gradient of expected-mask objective w.r.t. logits
rows.concept: Softmax jacobian of the differentiable mask loss
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = logits + a downstream scalar loss on the soft mask. Learner returns dL/dlogits. Oracle = finite-difference of the same loss. Grade max_abs_err < 1e-5; gate matches FD.

rows.title: Gradient of JSD(β) w.r.t. student logits
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student logits + β. Learner returns dJSD_β/d(student logits). Oracle = finite-difference. Grade max_abs_err<1e-5; gate matches FD.

rows.title: Gumbel-Softmax relaxed pattern sample
rows.concept: Deterministic-noise Gumbel-softmax over 6 patterns at temp τ
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = logits + FIXED Gumbel noise g + temperature τ. Learner returns softmax((logits+g)/τ). Oracle recomputes with the same g. Grade max_abs_err < 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Hard-concrete gate value & expected L0
rows.method: Sheared-LLaMA — targeted structured pruning + dynamic batch loading
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = gate log-alpha + stretch params (β, γ, ζ). Learner returns the gate value and expected L0 = sigmoid(logα - β·log(-γ/ζ)). Oracle recomputes. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Hidden-state cosine loss (DistilBERT 3rd term)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student hidden states. Learner returns the mean cosine-embedding loss and its gradient. Oracle recomputes + finite-differences. Grade loss rel_err<1e-6 AND grad<1e-5 FD; gate both.

rows.title: Hit a param budget after coupled slicing
rows.concept: Pick the width whose actual post-coupling param count meets budget
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = layer shapes + a param budget. Learner returns the chosen width and the exact param count after coupled slicing. Oracle sweeps widths, accounts for every coupled tensor. Grade param count == oracle AND <= budget; gate exact.

rows.title: Implement the Wanda score & per-output-row mask
rows.concept: S_ij = |W_ij|*||X_j||_2, top-(1-s) kept PER output row
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W (d_out x d_in) + X + s. Oracle computes S = |W|*norm(X,0)[None,:], row-wise top-k mask. Grade submitted mask == oracle mask elementwise; gate IoU==1.0.

rows.title: Intermediate-state (hidden) distillation loss
rows.concept: MSE between teacher & student hidden states through a projection
rows.method: Minitron pipeline — width+depth prune then distill
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher hidden H_t, student hidden H_s, projection P. Learner returns mean ||H_t - H_s P||^2. Oracle recomputes. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: JSD(β) limits recover forward/reverse KL
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = p,q + β near 0 and near 1. Learner returns JSD_β. Oracle shows it approaches the respective KL. Grade rel_err of the limits < 1e-4; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: KD gradient and the T² scale role
rows.concept: dL/ds + show T² restores gradient magnitude
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = logits + labels + two temperatures. Learner returns dL/ds. Oracle = finite-difference. Grade grad max_abs_err<1e-5 AND assert grad scale is T-invariant WITH T² but shrinks ~1/T² without it; gate FD + scale test.

rows.title: Lagrangian shape-constraint loss & gradient
rows.concept: L = task + λ(current_sparsity - target)² w.r.t. mask logits
rows.method: Sheared-LLaMA — targeted structured pruning + dynamic batch loading
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = mask logits + target sparsity + λ. Learner returns L and dL/dlogits. Oracle finite-differences. Grade grad max_abs_err<1e-5; gate matches FD.

rows.title: Lazy-batch (blocked) update equals full update
rows.concept: Blocksize B column batching reproduces per-column result
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X,s + blocksize B. Learner runs SparseGPT in column blocks with the lazy Hinv update. Oracle = the per-column (B=1) result. Grade Ŵ rel_err < 1e-6 vs the full update; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Learned soft mask vs one-shot magnitude 2:4
rows.concept: Retained magnitude of the converged distribution vs top-2
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a 4-group weight + converged per-group logits. Learner returns retained |w| (and WX-error) for the argmax-pattern mask and for the magnitude top-2 mask. Oracle recomputes both. Grade values within tol AND report which retains more; gate values match oracle.

rows.title: Levenshtein edit distance (MinED core)
rows.concept: DP edit distance between two token strings
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = pairs of token strings. Learner returns the edit distance. Oracle = standard DP. Grade exact_match integer; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Magnitude-optimal 2:4 mask
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = weight with last dim %4==0. Oracle = per-4-group argpartition top-2 by |w|. Grade mask == oracle AND valid 2:4 AND dropped Σ|w| == oracle minimum within 1e-9; gate exact.

rows.title: Magnitude vs Taylor head importance
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = head weights + one backprop gradient. Learner returns both rankings. Oracle computes group |w| and Σ|g*w| per head. Grade both rankings == oracle AND report that they differ; gate both exact.

rows.title: Map a learned mask to a target architecture
rows.method: Sheared-LLaMA — targeted structured pruning + dynamic batch loading
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-structure gate values + a target shape. Learner returns the resulting kept heads/layers/dims. Oracle keeps the top-scoring structures to hit the exact target. Grade shape + keep-sets == oracle; gate exact.

rows.title: Mean-activation vs L2 vs Taylor importance
rows.concept: Three importance signals on the same structures
rows.method: Minitron pipeline — width+depth prune then distill
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = activations + gradients per structure. Learner returns all three rankings. Oracle computes mean|a|, ||a||_2, |g*w| aggregates. Grade all three orders == oracle; gate exact.

rows.title: Measure 2:4 compute/memory reduction
rows.concept: Nonzero fraction and packed byte size
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = 2:4 fp16 weight. Learner reports density (0.5) and packed bytes (nnz*2 + 2-bit meta). Oracle recomputes. Grade size_ratio vs dense within 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Measure realized sparsity of a pruned checkpoint
rows.concept: Sparsity accounting: count exact zeros / total in a weight tensor
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a Llama MLP down_proj weight with some zeros. Learner returns (num_zeros, sparsity_ratio). Oracle recomputes np.count_nonzero(W==0)/W.size. Grade exact_match of both integers/ratio; gate ratio within 1 element.

rows.title: MinED vocab alignment map
rows.concept: Align teacher→student tokens by minimum edit distance
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher vocab + student vocab strings. Learner returns the teacher→student alignment (argmin edit distance, documented tie-break). Oracle recomputes. Grade exact_match of the mapping; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Mode-covering vs mode-seeking behavior
rows.concept: Forward-KL vs reverse-KL vs JSD on a bimodal teacher
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a bimodal teacher + a single-mode student family. Learner returns each divergence's value and the argmin-student it favors. Oracle recomputes; classifies each as mode-covering/seeking. Grade values within tol AND classification == oracle; gate both.

rows.title: Numeric equality: dense vs 2:4-compressed matmul
rows.concept: The kernel must preserve exact arithmetic
rows.method: Sparse inference serving (2:4 sparse + quant kernels)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W (2:4) + X. Learner returns max_abs_err between the compressed-path result and the dense masked result. Oracle recomputes both. Grade max_abs_err ~0 (<1e-6) AND matches oracle; gate matches.

rows.title: OBS single-weight saliency & closed-form update
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = small SPD H and weight row w. Oracle inverts H, computes analytic saliency + update. Grade: chosen prune index == argmin saliency (argmin_index) AND applied δw reproduces analytic ΔL within 1e-8; gate both.

rows.title: Optimal per-group int4 scales under the mask
rows.concept: Scales minimizing compound (masked+quantized) error given X
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X + group size. Learner returns per-group int4 scales minimizing ||(W⊙M)X - dequant(Q)X||^2 and the achieved MSE. Oracle grid-searches / solves per group. Grade MSE within tol AND <= naive absmax-scale MSE; gate optimum + ordering.

rows.title: Order matters: prune→quant vs quant→prune
rows.concept: Reconstruction error of the two orderings
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X. Learner returns reconstruction MSE for prune-then-quant (with re-reconstruction on survivors) and quant-then-prune. Oracle recomputes both. Grade both within tol AND assert prune-then-quant <= quant-then-prune; gate ordering + values.

rows.title: Orthogonal rotation invariance
rows.concept: W Q · Qᵀ x = W x for orthogonal Q
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W, x, orthogonal Q from eigh. Learner rotates: W'=W@Q, x'=Q.T@x, returns W'@x'. Oracle = W@x. Grade max_abs_err<1e-8; gate near-zero, matches oracle.

rows.title: Pack 2:4 into values + 2-bit index metadata
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a 2:4 weight. Learner emits the dense values array (2 per group) + 2-bit indices identifying kept positions per group. Oracle builds the same packing. Grade byte_exact_fraction of both buffers == 1.0; gate exact.

rows.title: Param/FLOP fraction removed by dropping k layers
rows.concept: Depth pruning removes whole blocks → linear savings
rows.method: Depth / layer pruning (angular distance, Block Influence) + heal
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-layer param counts + k dropped layers. Learner returns removed-param fraction and remaining size_ratio. Oracle sums the dropped layers' params. Grade size_ratio within 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: PCA slice error equals tail eigenvalue sum
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = X + keep-count k. Learner returns the projection error. Oracle = np.linalg.eigh tail sum. Grade |error - Σ tail λ| < 1e-8; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: PCA slice vs naive magnitude column drop
rows.concept: Same reduced dim, PCA should reconstruct better
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = X + reduced dim k. Learner returns reconstruction MSE for the PCA slice and for dropping the k smallest-norm raw columns. Oracle recomputes both. Grade both within tol AND PCA <= naive; gate ordering + values.

rows.title: Per-neuron FFN importance (group L2 norm)
rows.concept: Aggregate coupled in/out weights of a neuron into one score
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = MLP up_proj rows + down_proj cols for each hidden neuron. Learner returns the per-neuron group-L2 importance. Oracle = sqrt(||row||^2+||col||^2) per neuron. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Per-tensor vs global: per-layer sparsity drift
rows.concept: Show global pruning starves low-scale layers
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = multi-layer weights of differing scale. Learner returns the per-layer sparsity vector under global_unstructured AND the argmax (most-pruned) layer. Oracle recomputes both from the shared global threshold. Grade exact_match of the vector + argmin_index of the layer; gate exact.

rows.title: Prune FFN neurons to target width consistently
rows.concept: Slice up_proj rows AND down_proj cols by the same keep-set
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = up_proj, down_proj + target hidden width. Learner returns the kept-neuron set and the two sliced matrices. Oracle ranks by group importance, keeps top-k, slices both. Grade keep-set == oracle AND shapes match AND matmul remains valid; gate exact.

rows.title: Prune-then-quantize a layer
rows.concept: 2:4 mask, then per-group int4 on the survivors, dequantize
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W + group size + X (for the mask). Learner returns the dequantized compound weight (2:4 ⊙ int4). Oracle applies 2:4 top-2 then per-group absmax int4 then dequant. Grade max_abs_err<tol vs oracle; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Reconstruct dense weight from compressed 2:4
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = packed values + 2-bit index metadata. Learner reconstructs the dense tensor. Oracle = the original W⊙M. Grade exact_match elementwise; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Reconstruct error propagation to unvisited columns
rows.concept: How masking column q corrects the not-yet-pruned columns
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X + a fixed column-prune order. Learner returns the running compensated weights after each masked column (the Cholesky-driven correction). Oracle recomputes the sequence. Grade max_abs_err of the final Ŵ < 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Reconstruct pruned-layer output & residual
rows.concept: Apply the Wanda mask and report Y and the error
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X + the Wanda mask M. Learner returns Y=(W⊙M)X and the residual R=WX-Y. Oracle recomputes. Grade max_abs_err of Y and R < 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Reconstruct the pruned shell forward (pre-distill)
rows.concept: Sliced teacher on kept dims equals teacher restricted to those dims
rows.method: Minitron pipeline — width+depth prune then distill
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher weights + keep-sets + input. Learner returns the pruned model output. Oracle = teacher forward with the same rows/cols kept. Grade max_abs_err on kept dims<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Remove an attention head end-to-end
rows.concept: Drop head's q/k/v out-slice AND o_proj in-slice
rows.method: Structured width pruning (attention heads / FFN neurons) with dependency graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = attention weights + head to drop + input x. Learner returns the pruned weights and the block output. Oracle removes the coupled slices and recomputes. Grade max_abs_err of the output on kept dims < 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Reproduce torch l1_unstructured per-tensor mask
rows.concept: Zero the lowest-|w| entries to hit amount s exactly
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = q_proj weight + amount s. Oracle = torch.nn.utils.prune.l1_unstructured reference mask (equiv. numpy: keep flat-argsort top (1-s)*n by |w|). Grade submitted mask == oracle mask elementwise AND W*mask matches; gate IoU==1.0.

rows.title: Retained variance for a slice level
rows.concept: Slice fraction s → reduced dim and variance kept
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = eigenvalue spectrum + slice fraction s. Learner returns reduced dim and retained-variance ratio = Σ_{i<=k}λ / Σλ. Oracle recomputes. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: RigL grow step: top-|grad| among zeros
rows.concept: Activate the highest-gradient dead connections, init 0
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = dense gradient + post-drop mask + grow count. Learner returns the grown mask (+asserts regrown weights are 0). Oracle picks top-|grad| among currently-zero positions. Grade mask == oracle AND regrown values==0; gate exact.

rows.title: RigL vs SET regrowth
rows.concept: Gradient-informed vs random (seeded) regrow, same count
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = w, g, mask, seed. Learner returns both the RigL mask (top-|grad|) and the SET mask (seeded random among zeros). Oracle recomputes both. Grade both == oracle AND both conserve count; gate exact.

rows.title: rotate_and_slice on a two-layer stub
rows.concept: Fuse Q into adjacent weights and slice both
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = two coupled Linears + calibration X. Learner rotates layer1 output by Q, layer2 input by Qᵀ, slices the shared dim to k, returns end-to-end output. Oracle = full-rank output; error must equal the tail-eigenvalue bound. Grade output rel_err vs bound < 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Route to the right serving path
rows.method: Sparse inference serving (2:4 sparse + quant kernels)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = weights of varied sparsity pattern & ratio. Learner returns the chosen path per tensor. Oracle applies the routing rule (valid 2:4 → tensor-core; high unstructured → CSR; else dense). Grade exact_match; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Select keep-sets for a target (width, depth)
rows.concept: Two coupled budgets from two importance vectors
rows.method: Minitron pipeline — width+depth prune then distill
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = width-importance + layer-importance + targets (d_target, L_target). Learner returns both keep-sets. Oracle keeps top-d widths and top-L layers. Grade both == oracle; gate exact.

rows.title: Sequence-level KD hard target
rows.concept: CE on student logits against teacher greedy (argmax) tokens
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher logits (→argmax tokens) + student logits. Learner returns the seq-level KD CE loss. Oracle = CE(student, argmax(teacher)). Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Serving-format memory footprint
rows.method: Sparse inference serving (2:4 sparse + quant kernels)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a 2:4 (optionally int4) weight. Learner reports total served bytes and size_ratio vs fp16 dense. Oracle sums values + metadata + scales. Grade size_ratio within 1e-6; gate matches oracle.
