rows.title: Soft expected mask from pattern logits
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-group logits over 6 patterns. Learner returns the differentiable expected (soft) mask. Oracle = softmax(logits) @ pattern_matrix. Grade rel_err < 1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Sparse GEMM from compressed 2:4
rows.method: Sparse inference serving (2:4 sparse + quant kernels)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = packed 2:4 values + 2-bit indices + activation X. Learner computes Y via the compressed layout. Oracle = dense (W⊙M)@X. Grade max_abs_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: SparseGPT 2:4 mask via Hessian diagonal
rows.concept: Per 4-group keep 2 minimizing OBS error, not plain magnitude
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X. Oracle uses the SparseGPT metric w²/[Hinv]_qq to pick, per 4-group, the 2 survivors + applies the OBS update. Grade mask == oracle AND valid 2:4 AND reconstruction rel_err < 1e-5; gate exact + error.

rows.title: SparseGPT(2:4) then GPTQ(W4A16) mini-recipe
rows.concept: Two real modifiers composed on a small layer
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = deterministic W,X. Learner runs numpy SparseGPT 2:4 then GPTQ int4 (Hessian-ordered, per-column) on the survivors, returns reconstruction. Oracle runs the same pipeline. Grade ||WX-ŴX||_F rel_err<1e-5; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: SparseGPT vs Wanda vs magnitude at equal s
rows.concept: OBS reconstruction should beat activation- and magnitude-only
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X,s. Learner returns layer reconstruction MSE for all three methods. Oracle recomputes each. Grade all three within tol AND assert SparseGPT <= Wanda <= magnitude MSE; gate ordering + values.

rows.title: Straight-through estimator forward/backward
rows.concept: Hard argmax forward, soft-softmax surrogate gradient
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = logits + upstream grad. Learner returns the hard one-hot forward mask AND the STE surrogate gradient (softmax jacobian · upstream). Oracle recomputes. Grade forward exact_match AND grad rel_err<1e-5; gate both.

rows.title: Temperature limits of Gumbel-Softmax
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = logits + fixed g. Learner returns the selected pattern index at small τ and the distribution at large τ. Oracle = argmax(logits+g) and near-uniform. Grade argmin_index exact at small τ AND rel_err<1e-3 to uniform at large τ; gate both.

rows.title: Temperature-softened distribution
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = logits + T. Learner returns softmax(z/T). Oracle = stable softmax on z/T. Grade rel_err<1e-8; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: ULD gradient through the sort permutation
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student logits. Learner returns dULD/d(student logits) honoring the sort permutation. Oracle = finite-difference. Grade max_abs_err<1e-5; gate matches FD.

rows.title: ULD vs same-vocab KL on shared vocab
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = shared-vocab teacher/student + a perturbation sweep. Learner returns ULD and KL along the sweep. Oracle recomputes; asserts both ≥0 and hit 0 at p_t==p_s. Grade values within tol AND minimum at match; gate both.

rows.title: ULD Wasserstein-1 loss on sorted logits
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = teacher/student prob vectors (possibly different vocab sizes, padded). Learner returns the sorted-L1 transport loss. Oracle sorts both and sums |diff|. Grade rel_err<1e-6; gate matches oracle.

rows.title: Uniform vs reweighted expected loss
rows.concept: Effect of dynamic batch loading given a loss-vs-weight model
rows.method: Sheared-LLaMA — targeted structured pruning + dynamic batch loading
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = per-domain loss-as-function-of-weight coefficients. Learner returns expected total loss under uniform sampling and under the reweighted simplex. Oracle recomputes both. Grade both within tol AND report the reduction; gate values match oracle.

rows.title: Unpack cuSPARSELt metadata to a dense mask
rows.method: Sparse inference serving (2:4 sparse + quant kernels)
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = a 2-bit-per-group metadata buffer + shape. Learner reconstructs the boolean mask. Oracle = the original mask that produced it. Grade exact_match; gate 1.0.

rows.title: Wanda 2:4 variant per 4-group
rows.concept: Per consecutive 4 inputs keep the 2 largest Wanda scores
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X with d_in divisible by 4. Oracle scores S then, per output row per 4-group of inputs, keeps top-2 by S. Grade mask == oracle AND every 4-group has exactly 2 survivors; gate exact + valid 2:4.

rows.title: Wanda vs magnitude reconstruction error
rows.concept: Same sparsity, same X: Wanda should not lose more output energy
rows.method: Wanda (Pruning by Weights and Activations), one-shot
rows.how_to_grade: Fixture = W,X,s. Learner returns ||WX-(W⊙M)X||_F^2 for BOTH the Wanda mask and the pure-magnitude mask. Oracle recomputes both. Grade both MSE within 1e-6 AND assert Wanda_mse <= magnitude_mse; gate ordering holds + values match.

rows.title: 1F1B schedule ordering
rows.how_to_grade: Emit the 1F1B fwd/bwd op order per stage; exact_match vs reference schedule. Mac today.

rows.title: Acceptance-rate computation
rows.how_to_grade: Return expected acceptance = sum min(p,q) per position from draft q and target p (.npy); rel_err<1e-9. Mac today.

rows.title: Activation bytes saved by recompute vs store-P
rows.how_to_grade: Learner returns modeled activation bytes for store-P (N^2) vs recompute (O(Nd)); size_ratio matches analytic formula and <0.05 for N>>d. Mac today.

rows.title: Adam optimizer state bytes
rows.how_to_grade: Return optimizer bytes = 2*params*4 (fp32 m,v) [+fp32 master]; size_ratio vs formula ==1. Mac today.

rows.title: ALiBi additive bias inside online softmax
rows.how_to_grade: Add slope*(j-i) bias to scores within the streaming accumulation; match dense-ALiBi reference; max_abs_err<1e-5. Mac today.

rows.title: all-reduce = reduce-scatter + all-gather
rows.how_to_grade: Compose learner's reduce-scatter and all-gather; result must equal a direct all-reduce; max_abs_err<1e-6. Mac today.

rows.title: All-to-all for MoE dispatch
rows.how_to_grade: Simulate all-to-all exchanging per-expert token blocks; reassembled per-rank buffers max_abs_err<1e-6 vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Append-and-read incremental decode
rows.how_to_grade: Decode token-by-token appending K,V; per-step outputs must equal full-prefill attention slices; max_abs_err<1e-5. Mac today.

rows.title: Apply causal mask to dense scores
rows.how_to_grade: Set upper-triangular scores to -inf before softmax; output vs reference max_abs_err<1e-6. Grader checks masking is pre-softmax (post-mask probs are exactly 0 above diagonal). Mac today.

rows.title: Arithmetic intensity of a GEMM
rows.how_to_grade: Return FLOPs/byte for a [M,K]x[K,N] matmul in a given dtype; grader checks == 2MKN/(bytes read+written) within 1e-9. Mac today.

rows.title: Asymmetric zero-point round-trip
rows.how_to_grade: Affine quant with zero-point over an asymmetric range; dequant max_abs_err below step/2 vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Attainable performance from roofline
rows.how_to_grade: Return min(peak_flops, AI*bandwidth) per config; rel_err vs analytic<1e-9. Mac today.

rows.title: AWQ salient-channel scaling round-trip
rows.how_to_grade: Apply per-channel scaling to protect salient channels before quant; dequantized-matmul rel_err vs fp below plain-quant baseline. Mac today.

rows.title: Backward matches autograd under bf16-emulated rounding
rows.how_to_grade: Tiled backward with serial dQ accumulation across KV tiles, all intermediates rounded to bf16; match a bf16-emulated reference; max_abs_err<5e-3. Mac today.

rows.title: Batch size maximizing throughput under p99
rows.how_to_grade: Choose batch to maximize modeled throughput s.t. p99 latency<=SLO; gate achieved throughput size_ratio vs optimum<1.02. Mac today.

rows.title: bf16 matmul with fp32 accumulation error bound
rows.how_to_grade: Compute a matmul with bf16 inputs + fp32 accumulate; rel_err vs fp64 must be below a derived bound and above the all-bf16 error. Mac today.

rows.title: Block-count and wasted-slot arithmetic
rows.how_to_grade: Given block size and sequence lengths, return (blocks_allocated, wasted_slots) per sequence; exact_match vs ground truth. Mac today.

rows.title: Block-parametrized online softmax under bf16-emulated rounding
rows.how_to_grade: Learner's tiled softmax with arbitrary block size B must match a reference that rounds all intermediates to bf16 (emulated round-to-nearest-even) using the same B; max_abs_err<1e-3 over B in {16,64,256}. Mac today.

rows.title: Block-pointer indexing with boundary mask
rows.how_to_grade: Gather/scatter a 2D tile with row/col masks at edges; max_abs_err==0 vs reference slice. Mac today.

rows.title: Block-size choice minimizing modeled HBM
rows.how_to_grade: Given SRAM element budget M, learner picks Br,Bc; grader recomputes modeled HBM traffic and gates it below the known optimum*1.05. Mac today.

rows.title: Block-sparse equals dense on structurally-zero inputs
rows.how_to_grade: On inputs where off-pattern blocks are exactly zero, block-sparse output must equal dense; max_abs_err<1e-6, plus learner reports modeled FLOP savings ratio. Mac today.

rows.title: Block-table append + gather attention
rows.how_to_grade: Implement block allocator + logical->physical gather; attention over gathered blocks vs contiguous-cache reference; max_abs_err<1e-5. Mac today.

rows.title: Bucket grads to maximize overlap
rows.how_to_grade: Partition grads into buckets so backward compute hides all-reduce; gate exposed-comm size_ratio vs optimum<1.05. Mac today.

rows.title: Build a minimal op-DAG tracer
rows.how_to_grade: Trace a small function into a node list (op,args,out); grader compares the canonicalized DAG to reference; exact_match. Mac today.

rows.title: Capacity factor + token dropping
rows.how_to_grade: Given capacity C, return the kept/dropped mask per token; exact_match vs reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Causal FlashAttention forward with KV early-exit
rows.how_to_grade: Causal tiled forward skipping KV tiles beyond the diagonal and emitting LSE; max_abs_err<1e-5 vs dense causal reference, plus settrace confirms skipped tiles are never scored. Mac today.

rows.title: Causal folded into tiling with early-exit
rows.how_to_grade: Tiled causal attention skipping fully-future KV tiles and diagonal-masking partial tiles; max_abs_err<1e-5 vs dense causal; settrace confirms skipped tiles unscored. Mac today.

rows.title: Chunk-size selection to bound decode stall
rows.concept: Prefill vs decode phases & chunked prefill
rows.how_to_grade: Pick chunk size minimizing modeled decode stall under a token-budget; gate achieved stall size_ratio vs optimum<1.05. Mac today.

rows.title: Chunked prefill reproduces KV + tokens
rows.concept: Prefill vs decode phases & chunked prefill
rows.how_to_grade: Split a long prompt into chunks interleaved with ongoing decodes; final KV-cache and emitted tokens must exact_match a monolithic prefill+decode run. Mac today.

rows.title: Classify fusable op pairs
rows.how_to_grade: Label op pairs as fusable/not (elementwise-elementwise yes, across reduction/gemm rules); exact_match vs ground truth. Mac today.

rows.title: Classify graph breaks
rows.how_to_grade: Label snippets as traceable vs graph-break (data-dependent control flow / unsupported op); exact_match vs ground truth. Mac today.

rows.title: Classify overlappable ops from DAG
rows.how_to_grade: Given a dependency DAG, return which comm ops can overlap which compute ops; exact_match vs ground truth. Mac today.

rows.title: Classify roofline region of a phase
rows.concept: Prefill vs decode phases & chunked prefill
rows.how_to_grade: For (batch,seq,d,machine-balance) configs, return compute/bandwidth-bound label per config; exact_match vs ground truth from AI vs ridge point. Mac today.

rows.title: Coalesced vs strided access transactions
rows.how_to_grade: Return memory-transaction count for a warp accessing global memory coalesced vs strided; grader checks vs the 32-thread transaction model exactly. Modeled on Mac; verify CUDA phase.

rows.title: Column+row parallel MLP equivalence
rows.how_to_grade: Shard MLP as column-parallel then row-parallel across N ranks with an all-reduce; output must equal unsharded MLP; max_abs_err<1e-5. Mac today.

rows.title: Compensated (Kahan) summation in low precision
rows.how_to_grade: Sum a large fp16 array with Kahan compensation; rel_err vs fp64 sum below the naive-fp16 error by a required margin. Mac today.

rows.title: Compute-bound vs memory-bound classification
rows.how_to_grade: Given AI per kernel and machine balance (peak FLOPs/BW), return bound label per kernel; exact_match vs ground truth (AI vs ridge). Mac today.

rows.title: Constant-fold a traced graph
rows.how_to_grade: Fold constant subgraphs; grader checks folded graph structure exact_match reference and that evaluating it matches the original outputs. Mac today.

rows.title: Contiguous vs strided decode access count
rows.how_to_grade: Model memory-access count for a decode read over [b,h,s,d] contiguous vs strided layouts; grader checks counts match the layout cost model exactly. Mac today.

rows.title: Copy-on-write prefix sharing
rows.how_to_grade: Two samples share a prompt's physical blocks until divergence (COW on first write); each branch output must equal an independent run; max_abs_err<1e-5. Mac today.

rows.title: Cost-model schedule ranking
rows.how_to_grade: Rank candidate schedules by a provided cost model; exact_match vs the reference ordering (which matches the measured proxy). Mac today.

rows.title: Count HBM round-trips of matmul+bias+act
rows.how_to_grade: Return modeled HBM round-trips fused vs unfused; grader checks vs the traffic model exactly. Mac today.

rows.title: Data-parallel grad averaging equals big-batch
rows.how_to_grade: Split a batch across N shards, compute per-shard grads, average; must equal single big-batch grad; max_abs_err<1e-6. Mac today (CPU simulation of ranks).

rows.title: Dead-code elimination on FX-like graph
rows.how_to_grade: Remove nodes not reachable from outputs; resulting node set exact_match reference. Mac today.

rows.title: Derive and evaluate the (m,l,o) merge operator
rows.how_to_grade: Learner implements merge((m1,l1,o1),(m2,l2,o2)) closed form. Grade by merging two partial states computed from halves of each row and comparing to full-row softmax@V on fixtures; max_abs_err<1e-6. Mac today.
